closers: compliment: Maybe me not eat you.
insult: Run away now, little one.
compliment|remark: I hope that's what you wanted.

openers: compliment|remark: Ah, 'tis a foine day to be sure!

closers: insult: Go away human, we busy.
I'm keeping an eye on you.
insult: Or I eat you instead!
insult|remark: Good luck. It is far from simple.
compliment|remark: How may I help you?
greetings: Welcome to {place} bank, {you}. How may I help?
Welcome to {place} bank, {you}. Mind the queue.
Welcome to {place} bank, {you}. Do come in.

closers: The collection plate's by the door.

openers: What can I do yer for?
closers: compliment|remark: Mind the step on your way out.

openers: Have a look at my wares.
closers: compliment|remark: Do come by the shop.
insult|remark: Come back when you've coins.

compliment: A staff like a sliver of sun. Desert work, surely. Ye gods.
insult: A {item}. I do hope someone showed you how it works.
All that weapon, and nobody to point it at. Shame.
sharp/insult: A staff worth a kingdom, carried like a walking stick. Some people.
remark: Don't leave that {item} lying about, round here.
That staff glows. Does it do that at night? Must be murder to sleep.
kid/compliment: Is that real? Can I have it when you die?
kid/remark: Whoa. What's that?
trader/compliment: Three coins for that {item}. And that's generous.
banker/remark: You're carrying more than this branch holds. Do come in.
shady/remark: Nice {item}. Be a shame if it went missing.
guard/insult: That's a lot of weapon for market day. Keep it sheathed.
No trouble in town. I've seen what that thing costs.
heartland/compliment: Is that a {item}? Gadzooks. I'd have to sell the farm.

compliment: That's no farm tool. Whatever that reaps, it isn't corn.
insult: A scythe. Are you Death, or just the help?
All that weapon, and nobody to point it at. Shame.
sharp/insult: A scythe that size. Never once cut so much as a weed, I'll wager.
remark: Don't leave that {item} lying about, round here.
Mind the doorways with that scythe. And the lanterns. And me.
kid/compliment: Is that real? Can I have it when you die?
kid/remark: Are you a farmer? A scary one?
trader/compliment: A scythe, my friend? I've a field wants doing. Call it a trial.
banker/remark: Do keep that scythe clear of the counter. The paperwork alone.
shady/remark: Nice {item}. Be a shame if it went missing.
guard/insult: That's a lot of blade for market day. Keep it on your back.
No trouble in town. I've seen what that thing costs.
heartland/compliment: A scythe like that. Gadzooks. Harvest's not till autumn, you know.

compliment: A bow like a twisted branch. Gadzooks. Who grew that?
That bow's bent. Oh. It's meant to be. Lovely, then.
insult: A twisted bow. Hope your aim's straighter than it is.
All that bow, and the rabbits still get away, I'll bet.
sharp/insult: A bow worth a castle, and you hold it like a fishing rod.
remark: Don't leave that {item} lying about, round here.
A bow like that, the arrows must feel underdressed.
kid/compliment: Is that real? Can I have it when you die?
kid/remark: Your bow's all bendy! Did you sit on it?
trader/compliment: That bow, my friend. I'd offer the shop, but you'd want the stock too.
banker/remark: A bow of that value walking about. I've gone quite pale. Do come in.
shady/remark: Nice {item}. Be a shame if it went missing.
guard/insult: That's a lot of bow for market day. Unstring it.
No trouble in town. I've seen what that thing costs.
tzhaar/compliment: Bendy bow. Looks like nothing. Shoots like TzHaar-Xil. Rare JalYt.
tzhaar/remark: Twisted bow. JalYt pay a mountain of TokKul for that, they say.
tzhaar/insult: Bow is bent. Did JalYt sit on it? TzHaar-Hur can fix. For TokKul.
ogre/compliment: Bendy bow! Creature shoots da chompies from far. Clever creature.
ogre/insult: Bow's all twisted. Creature sat on it? Ogres sit on fings too.
ogre/remark: Dat bow is worth all da bright pretties, dey say. Ogre not see why.
gnome/compliment: A twisted bow! Great Guthix, human. Did it grow like that?
gnome/remark: A bow like a branch of the Grand Tree. Did you ask the tree first?
dwarf/compliment: A twisted bow. Not metal, but by Guthix, that's craftsmanship.
dwarf/insult: A bent bit of wood. Worth a mountain of gold, they say. Humans.
fremennik/compliment: A bow like a twisted root. Sigli would hunt with that gladly.
fremennik/insult: A bent bow worth a fleet. The sagas prefer axes.
moon_clan/compliment: A twisted bow. It was grown, not made, I think. So were you, dear.
moon_clan/remark: Oh my. Everyone who passes is thinking about that bow. Noisily.
tortugan/compliment: A twisted bow. It bends like coral. Very fine.
tortugan/insult: Bent like driftwood. Humans will pay anything for a tool.
goblin/insult: Bendy bow. Human shoot from far away? Not run from battle, human!
goblin/remark: Bow all twisted. Human sit on it? Bentnoze sit on things.
goblin/compliment: Twisty bow. Shoot far. Shoot beardy-short-people from far. Good.
troll/insult: Bendy bow. Shoot from far away? Trolls chuck rocks from far too.
troll/remark: Twisted bow. Look like root. Root is troll name. Good name.
troll/compliment: Twisty bow. Shoot far. Trolls like far. Far is where rocks go.
barbarian/compliment: The swift arrow on the wind. Aitan would want a go with that bow.
barbarian/insult: A bow that bent? Hah! Did you win it or wrestle it?
barbarian/remark: Twisted bow. Fine for the wind. A sword for the longhall, mind.

compliment: Not a stitch on you. You're braver than I am, traveller.
Well, nobody can say you're hiding anything.
insult: Lost your clothes, adventurer? Or did they lose you?
Bit chilly to be dressed in nothing but confidence.
plain/insult: Put some clothes on! There are children about.
Absolutely starkers. In public!
sharp/insult: Dressed in nothing but your own good opinion, I see.
remark: Laundry day, is it?
Not even a vest? Brave.
kid/insult: Mum! That one's got no clothes on!
Ewww! Put something on!
kid/remark: Why are you in your pants?
nan/remark: Ooh, put something on, dear. You'll catch your death.
vicar/insult: Trousers are customary in the churchyard. Not required. Customary.
banker/remark: Clothing isn't required in the bank. It is a courtesy.
toff/insult: Has the peasantry given up on trousers entirely? One wasn't told.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! No armour at all. A warrior's spirit, outerlander.
Hah! Bare as a newborn and still walking tall. There is nerve in that.
No cloth, no steel. Only the arm. That is how Thorvald likes it.
pirate/remark: Arr, lost yer shirt at cards, did ye?
guard/insult: Oi! Clothes. Public thoroughfare. Now.
This is a city, not a bathhouse. Find a towel.
Trousers or the cells. Your choice.
guard/remark: Put something on or I'll have to write this down.
Don't make me write 'no trousers' in the log again.
gnome/insult: Not even a hat, human? Hats are the one thing you lot get right.
Not a stitch on, and still slower than a gnome. Remarkable.
rough/insult: Cor. Not a stitch. Ye'll frighten the sheep.
rough/remark: Blimey. Put something on before the cows see.
barkeep/insult: No shirt, no service. And I'm being generous about the rest.
barkeep/remark: Lost your clothes in my cellar, did you? I'll have a look.
dwarf/remark: No armour at all? By Guthix, I feel cold just looking.
Lost your armour? Any smith worth his beard could sort you out.
dwarf/insult: No armour, no beard. What exactly are you working with?
Nothing to judge the craftsmanship of. A first for me.
fremennik/insult: Thorvald's trial is fought unarmoured. Not unclothed, outerlander.
Peer asks you to carry nothing. He did not mean your clothes.
A yak has more hide on it, and the yak did not choose that.
burgher/remark: No clothes? Even we've got clothes. Just about.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt wear nothing? Soft skin, no armour. Lava will not be kind.
No clothes, JalYt. Leaking water and shame. Strange creature.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt has no shell. TzHaar born with ours. Is better way.
tzhaar/compliment: No armour, still walk into Mor Ul Rek. Brave JalYt. Or daft one.
ogre/insult: Creature wiv no skin on! Hur, hur. Saves da peeling.
ogre/remark: No clothes, creature? Easier for da cooking pot, me suppose.
ogre/compliment: Creature got no clothes. Goodly. Less to pick out of da teeth.
gnome/compliment: Kar, no armour at all! Brave, human. Big, but brave.
gnome/remark: Even the gnomeball players wear shorts, human.
dwarf/compliment: No armour and no fear. By Guthix, that's one way to live.
fremennik/remark: The Longhall bouncer would have words. Short ones.
moon_clan/compliment: Nothing to hide, inside or out. How refreshing, dear.
You dream unclothed too. I had a look. Very consistent.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. I read minds, dear. I never asked to read the rest.
Your thoughts are quite bare too, dear. I checked.
moon_clan/remark: On the island we would simply conjure a robe. Do try thinking of one.
tortugan/compliment: No shell, no clothes, still at ease. Very well. That is confidence.
We are born with shells. You go without even a borrowed one. Brave.
tortugan/insult: We are born with shells. You seem to have mislaid yours.
Humans need a tool for everything. Clothes too, I had thought.
tortugan/remark: At sea, nobody minds. On land, people seem to mind a great deal.
goblin/insult: Human got no armour! Not red, not green, not brown. Not anything!
Skin armour. Green too much like skin, Bentnoze say. This is worse.
goblin/remark: No clothes, human? Even Grubfoot wear armour. Orange one, once.
goblin/compliment: Human fight naked? Not run from battle, even with no armour. Good.
troll/insult: Human got no shell on. Less crunchy. Trolls like less crunchy.
No metal clothes? Good. Red metal hurt troll teeth.
troll/remark: Human wear nothing. Troll wear nothing too. Troll got rock skin, mind.
troll/compliment: Skin only? Brave human. Rocks hurt skin. Me know, me chuck dem.
cat/remark: No fur, no clothes. How do you humans keep warm at all?
cat/insult: Bare skin on a human. Hairless and proud of it. Odd creatures.
cat/compliment: No clothes to shed on. Sensible, that. Very sensible.
camel/remark: Bare skin in this sun. You'll be a different colour by dusk.
camel/insult: No hide, no hair, no shame. I'll look at the horizon instead.
camel/compliment: Brave, going about with no hide. Foolish, but brave.
leprechaun/remark: Not a stitch on ye. 'Tis the compost ye'll be smellin' of next.
leprechaun/insult: Nay, I'll not be holdin' yer clothes. Ye've none to hold!
leprechaun/compliment: Foine and brave, goin' about like that. Daft, but brave.
parrot/insult: Squawk! Put it away! Put it away!
mos_pirate/remark: Not a stitch on ye. Did the Horrors get yer clothes?
mos_pirate/insult: Arr, put somethin' on. Even the powder monkey wears breeches.
mos_pirate/compliment: Bold as brass, goin' about like that. I'll give ye that.
moon_clan_wary/insult: I read minds, not bodies. Put something on.
Outsiders are loud and unguarded, they say. Clearly.
Nothing on, and nothing within. I checked.
moon_clan_wary/remark: We clothe ourselves by magic. You seem to have given up entirely.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Nothing hidden, inside or out. Honest. I will grant you that much.
barbarian/insult: No clothes at all? Hah! Is this how city folk fight now?
Starkers in our village? Even Gunthor wears a helmet.
barbarian/remark: Not a stitch on. Brave, that. Or the longhall beer's been at you.
barbarian/compliment: Fighting in your skin! Ho ho! There's barbarian blood in you.

compliment: Is that an infernal cape? You went into the Inferno? Blimey.
Fair play. Nobody gets a cape like that by accident.
insult: Lovely cape. Shame about the rest of you.
sharp/insult: Sat in lava for a cape. The things some will do for attention.
remark: Takes a certain sort to sit in lava for fun.
My cousin went into the Inferno once. Never been right since.
kid/compliment: Whoa, is that the lava one?!
Can I touch it? Is it still hot?
kid/insult: My dad says he could do that. He couldn't.
nan/remark: Lovely cape. Did your mother know you went in the lava?
fremennik/compliment: Hah! Walked through fire and kept the cape. Respect.
Into the Inferno and out again. That is a saga, not a story.
pirate/compliment: Through the Inferno, were ye? Arr, I'd have sailed round.
barkeep/compliment: Into the lava and back? That cape drinks free tonight.
tzhaar/compliment: Cape of lava. JalYt stood before TzKal-Zuk and walked out. Rare.
TzKal-Zuk hungers for memories. JalYt gave him none. TzHaar remember.
tzhaar/remark: Lava cape. TzHaar-Hur did not make that one. Inferno did.
That cape came from Inferno. Our old birthing pool. Went too deep.
tzhaar/insult: Champion of the Inferno. Still JalYt. Still leaking.
Lava cape on a JalYt. Lava should be more careful.
ogre/compliment: Lava cape! Red and burny! Bestest pretty me ever seen, creature.
ogre/insult: Creature wears lava and still looks like a snack. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Dat cape is dripping fire. Keep it off da chompy feathers.
heartland/compliment: That cape. You're proper hard, you are.
heartland/insult: Infernal cape, is it? Bit flash for popping to the shops.
gnome/compliment: An infernal cape! Megal! You went into the Inferno and came out!
gnome/insult: Down into the Inferno, and still slow up a ladder. Humans.
gnome/remark: That cape looks heavy, human. Even for one of the big folk.
dwarf/compliment: An infernal cape. By Guthix. That's hotter than any forge I've seen.
dwarf/remark: Lava-born, that cape. Even the Consortium can't buy one.
fremennik/remark: Olaf would sing of that cape. Badly, but at length.
moon_clan/compliment: That cape came from a place worse than any dream. And you woke.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. That cape is very warm. So is your opinion of it, dear.
tortugan/compliment: A cape from the deep fire. A gryphon would think twice. Once, anyway.
tortugan/remark: The deep fire, they say. We keep to the deep water. Each to their own.
goblin/compliment: Lava cape! Very red! Thorobshuun red! Human mighty warrior.
goblin/insult: Cape of fire. Human still ugly behind it. Fire not help.
goblin/remark: Human cape is burning. Mudknuckles cooking look like that.
troll/compliment: Cape of lava! Trolls scared of fire. Human not. Human scary.
troll/insult: Fire cape very red. Me still not scared. Me little bit scared.
troll/remark: Cape burning. Human walk around burning. Humans strange.
barbarian/compliment: A cape of living fire. Ho ho! There's a saga in that.
barbarian/insult: Lava on your back and still you walk like city folk.
barbarian/remark: That cape's burning. Mind the beer barrels.

compliment: Is that a real {item}? Ye gods.
That {item} is worth more than this whole town.
insult: A paper hat worth a castle. Gielinor's a funny old place.
Wearing a {item} round here? Brave, or daft.
plain/insult: That {item}'s out of a cracker, surely.
trader/compliment: Swap you that hat for a cabbage. Final offer.
kid/compliment: Is that a crown?
Can I have your hat?
kid/insult: It's a paper hat. My nan's got loads.
shady/remark: Lovely hat. Plenty of dark alleys between here and the bank.
toff/insult: One's grandfather had one of those. He had the face for it.
pirate/compliment: Arr, a hat worth more than me ship. Mind it in the harbour.
barkeep/remark: A hat like that, the Party Room'll want you.
burgher/remark: Funny paper hat. You lose a bet?
heartland/remark: Mind that {item} in Lumbridge. Light fingers about.
Wouldn't fancy walking that past Edgeville.
tzhaar/compliment: Paper hat worth more than all your armour, they say. Funny JalYt.
tzhaar/insult: Paper hat in city of fire. Silly JalYt. Very silly.
tzhaar/remark: Paper hat. Hold it away from lava. Paper burns. JalYt too, but slower.
ogre/compliment: Pretty paper hat! Bright pretty! Give it to ogre. Ogre asked nice.
ogre/insult: Paper hat. Hur, hur. Creature wearing its own lunch wrapper.
ogre/remark: Dat hat is worth lots, dey say. Ogre can't eat it. So, no.
gnome/compliment: A paper hat worth a kingdom. Humans are a mystery, and a marvel.
gnome/insult: A {item}? Kar, you can't fly a glider in that. Blows right off.
dwarf/compliment: A {item}. Worth more than a Consortium seat, they say. Mind it.
dwarf/insult: A {item}. Not forged, not mined, not earned. Just old.
dwarf/remark: Paper, worth a mountain of gold. By Guthix, I'll never understand.
fremennik/compliment: A paper hat worth a fleet. The sagas would not believe it.
fremennik/insult: A paper hat. The sea would have it off you in a breath.
moon_clan/compliment: A paper hat worth a kingdom. Only a dreamer would wear one. Good.
moon_clan/remark: Oh my. Half the street is thinking about your hat. Loudly.
tortugan/compliment: A paper hat worth so much. You keep it dry. That is the hard part.
tortugan/insult: Paper, at sea? That hat would last one wave, human.
goblin/compliment: Paper hat! Pretty colour! Human give to goblin? Goblin ask nice.
goblin/insult: Paper hat on head. Not helmet. Human get hit on head, paper not help.
goblin/remark: Paper hat worth lots, humans say. Humans stupid with money.
troll/compliment: Paper hat! Pretty colour. Human give me? Me eat it. Still pretty.
troll/insult: Paper hat. Not stop rock. Rock go straight through. Me try?
troll/remark: Paper hat worth lots, humans say. Troll eat it, worth nothing. Funny.
parrot/insult: Squawk! Peck it! Peck the hat!
mos_pirate/remark: A paper hat. Worth more'n the whole town, they say.
mos_pirate/compliment: Arr, now that be plunder worth the takin'.
mos_pirate/insult: Paper hat in a pirate town? Bold, or daft, landlubber.
guard/remark: Paper hat worth a castle. I'll be walking very close behind you.
guard/insult: Wearing that in the street. You want robbing, and then you'll want me.
guard/compliment: A {item}. Half the thieves in town just noticed. So did I.
barbarian/insult: A paper hat! Peksa sells proper helmets, you know.
barbarian/remark: Paper on your head. One axe and it's confetti.
barbarian/compliment: A paper hat in a barbarian village. Hah! That takes nerve.

compliment: A master of everything, they say. Remarkable.
That cape, adventurer! Is there anything you can't do?
insult: A cape for being good at everything. Except modesty.
remark: Must have taken you years, that.
Your mother must be ever so proud. Or worried.
kid/compliment: Is that the cape for being the best at everything?
wizard/insult: A master of everything. Of magic too? We shall see.
fremennik/compliment: Master of everything? Hah! Can you drink, though?
Master of every craft. The council would vote for you at once.
heartland/insult: Master of everything, they say. Queues included? Back of the line.
tzhaar/compliment: That cape say JalYt master all. Mej, Ket, Xil, Hur. All one JalYt.
tzhaar/remark: Big cape. Many colours. TzHaar only need one colour. Red.
tzhaar/insult: Cape for being good at everything. Hot air too, TzHaar guess.
ogre/compliment: Big fancy cape wiv all da colours! Creature must be da biggun.
ogre/insult: Cape for being best at everyfing? Best at running away, maybe.
ogre/remark: Dat cape got lots of colours. Chompies would peck it. Me would too.
gnome/compliment: Master of everything? Even gnomeball, human? Now I'm impressed.
gnome/insult: Good at everything, human. Except being small. We win there.
dwarf/compliment: Master of every craft? Then your smithing's as good as mine. Nearly.
dwarf/remark: A cape for every skill. Years well spent, human.
fremennik/insult: Master of everything. Fine. Face Koschei unarmed, then say so.
moon_clan/compliment: A master of everything. Even yourself? That is the one that matters.
moon_clan/remark: A cape for mastering everything. Do you dream of it still? Yes. I see.
tortugan/compliment: Master of all things. It took patience. That, we understand.
tortugan/insult: Master of everything, they say. Everything on land, perhaps.
goblin/insult: Cape of many colours. Pick one colour, human! Even goblins pick one.
goblin/remark: Big cape with all colours. Red, green, blue... No brown. Shame.
goblin/compliment: Human good at everything, cape say. Even fighting? Then good.
troll/compliment: Big cape, all colours. Human good at everything, dey say. Even eating?
troll/insult: Fancy cape. Human good at everything? Try climbing icy mountain.
troll/remark: Cape of all colours. Trolls got one colour. Rock colour.
parrot/remark: Squawk! Pretty cape! All the colours!
mos_pirate/remark: All them colours. Ye look like a signal flag.
mos_pirate/compliment: Master of everythin', that cape says. Even the sea?
mos_pirate/insult: Fancy cape. Can ye tie a knot, though?
moon_clan_wary/insult: A cape for mastering everything. Did it come with patience? No. I see.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Mastery of every craft. And yet you came for ours. Hmph.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Master of everything, they say. Everything but yourself. A start.
guard/compliment: That cape. Master of everything, they say. Try standing still.
guard/remark: Done everything, that cape says. Not a shift on the gate, I'd wager.
guard/insult: Master of everything, and still walking through my gate like anyone.
barbarian/compliment: Good at everything, that cape says. Even drinking? Prove it.
barbarian/insult: A cape for being good at everything. Fighting too? We'll see.
barbarian/remark: Cape of every colour. Ours are furs. Furs don't boast.

compliment: You look like something that eats knights. In a good way.
You look like the end of the world in that. Ye gods.
insult: Who's in there? Is it still you?
remark: How do you even see out of that?
Bet that's murder on the shoulders.
kid/compliment: You look like the scary one in Mum's stories!
guard/insult: Armour like that, I'm keeping both eyes on you. Wish I'd a third.
dwarf/compliment: I don't know who forged that, but I'd buy them a beer. Two.
heartland/insult: Very fearsome. You'll frighten the chickens.
tzhaar/compliment: That armour look like it ate something. JalYt look dangerous. Good.
tzhaar/remark: Dark armour, heavy. Is JalYt in there? TzHaar cannot tell.
tzhaar/insult: Big fearsome armour. TzHaar-Ket still bigger. Nice try, JalYt.
ogre/compliment: Grrr! Big scary creature! Ogre nearly stepped back. Nearly.
ogre/insult: All dat scary armour and creature still smells like a toady.
ogre/remark: Creature in dat armour looks like a ogre. Little ogre. Hur, hur.
gnome/compliment: Megal! Human, you look like a war all by yourself.
gnome/remark: The children hid when they saw you, human. Don't take it personally.
dwarf/insult: Armour like a siege engine. Shame you move like one, human.
dwarf/remark: Ancient work, that armour. Forged before our history books begin.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! You look like a thing from a saga. The part the children fear.
fremennik/remark: Armour like that, and the trolls would move camp.
moon_clan/compliment: Fearsome armour. Gentle thoughts inside it. I rather like that.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. Armour like a nightmare, dear. I have had better ones.
tortugan/compliment: A shell like that, you need fear no gryphon. Perhaps the other way.
tortugan/remark: Dark heavy armour. In the water you would go straight down.
goblin/compliment: Big scary armour. Human nearly look like goblin champion. Nearly.
goblin/insult: Big dark armour. Human inside still small human. Me can tell.
goblin/remark: That armour heavy. Human walk like Wartface after beetle pie.
troll/compliment: Big dark armour. Human look like Dad. Dad is big troll. Is compliment.
troll/insult: Who in dere? Human? Troll crack it open an' see.
troll/remark: Heavy armour. Human sink in sea like troll now.
barbarian/compliment: Dark armour like a mountainside. Who's in there, a giant?
barbarian/insult: All that black plate and such a small person inside. Hah!
barbarian/remark: Armour like a mountain. Our forefathers would've charged it anyway.

compliment: A fire cape! Nicely done, that.
Fair play. You earned that the hard way.
insult: A fire cape. Lovely. The infernal one's redder, mind.
Fire cape. Took a few goes, I expect.
remark: Ooh, toasty.
kid/compliment: Your cape's on fire!
kid/insult: It's not even hot. I checked.
fremennik/compliment: A cape won in fire. The sagas would have a verse for that.
Won in fire. A trophy like that deserves a verse. A good one, even.
heartland/remark: Mind you don't set the hedges off.
tzhaar/compliment: Fire cape. JalYt beat TzTok-Jad. TzHaar-Ket let you deeper now.
That cape was earned in Fight Cave. TzHaar know. TzHaar watched.
tzhaar/remark: TzHaar-Mej-Jal give TokKul for that cape. Keep it. Fire worth more.
Fire cape opens inner city. Deeper. Hotter. Mind yourself, JalYt.
tzhaar/insult: Fire cape warm JalYt, no? JalYt still cold inside. Is in the name.
Fire cape. Good. TzHaar-Ket-Keh want one too, before Inferno.
ogre/compliment: Ooh, creature's cape is on fire! Bestest cape. Me wants it.
ogre/insult: Cape on fire and creature not even cooked. Wasteful.
ogre/remark: Dat burny cape, creature. Good for da stew pot. Hur, hur.
gnome/compliment: A fire cape! Great Guthix, human. Did you have to stand in the fire?
gnome/remark: Keep that cape away from the Grand Tree. It's a tree, human.
dwarf/compliment: A fire cape! Not smithed, but earned. That counts, human.
dwarf/insult: Fire cape. Fine. Can it stop an axe? Didn't think so.
dwarf/remark: That cape would do nicely by the forge. Warm, I'd say.
fremennik/insult: A fine cape. The fire did the hard work. You only stood in it.
moon_clan/compliment: A cape of fire. You walked through a nightmare awake, dear.
moon_clan/remark: Oh my. That cape is still thinking about the heat. So are you.
tortugan/compliment: A cape of fire. We know water trials. Yours sounds worse.
tortugan/insult: Fire on your back. Do not come swimming in it, human.
goblin/compliment: Fire cape! Red and orange! Red best, Bentnoze say. Me like.
goblin/insult: Burny cape. Human stand in fire for cape? Humans stupid. Nice cape.
goblin/remark: Cape is orange-ish. Grubfoot wear orange once. Look like orange-fruit.
troll/compliment: Fire cape. Human stand in fire? Trolls not like fire. Brave human.
troll/insult: Burny cape. Keep it away. Trolls not like fire. Not funny.
troll/remark: Cape made of fire. Human cook self already. Save troll cook a job.
parrot/remark: Squawk! Fire! Fire! Feed the fires!
parrot/insult: Squawk! Keep it off me feathers! Off me feathers!
mos_pirate/remark: Fire cape, eh? Keep it away from the powder.
mos_pirate/compliment: Arr, that be a hard-won cape, and no mistake.
mos_pirate/insult: Burny cape. Don't ye go near the rum stores with that.
moon_clan_wary/insult: A cape of fire. Loud, like the rest of your thoughts.
moon_clan_wary/remark: That cape fought something terrible. It did not teach you patience.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: A cape of fire. A trial survived. Ours is harder. Still, I grant it.
guard/remark: That cape's on fire. Keep it off the thatch.
guard/insult: A burning cape inside the walls. That's a fire risk, and a report.
guard/compliment: Fire cape. Earned the hard way, I hear. Still no smoking in town.
barbarian/compliment: You stood in fire for that cape. Hah! That's barbarian spirit.
barbarian/insult: A fire cape? Keep it off the thatch. We like our longhall.
barbarian/remark: Cape of fire. The longhall fire never goes out either.

compliment: Ooh, a {item}. Very rare, that.
insult: Bit early for Halloween, isn't it?
remark: Gave me a right turn, that mask.
kid/compliment: Scary mask! Do it again!
kid/insult: You're not scary. My sister's scarier.
nan/insult: Take the mask off, dear. Oh. Oh, I'm so sorry.

compliment: Not many can carry off a bald head. You can.
Nothing up top to slow you down. Good for running.
insult: I can see my reflection in that head.
plain/insult: Lost your hair, or just misplaced it?
Bald as a coot, you.
sharp/insult: Not a hair left. Did it leave of its own accord, or was it pushed?
remark: Must save you a fortune on combs.
kid/insult: Why have you got no hair?
Mum! That one's bald!
Your head looks like an egg.
nan/remark: Hat on, dear. You'll catch your death with a head like that.
toff/insult: Has someone pinched your hair, citizen? One shall have words.
trader/remark: I've a lovely wig out the back, my friend. A bargain.
wizard/insult: Bald? A pity. I know a spell for that. It doesn't work, but I know it.
banker/remark: Hats are permitted in the bank. Just so you know.
gnome/insult: A head like a gnomeball. Stay well clear of the pitch, human.
pirate/insult: Arr, a head like a cannonball. Mind the gunners.
pirate/remark: A bald head and no hat? The gulls'll have ye, matey.
rough/insult: Head like a peeled turnip, that.
rough/remark: Ye'll want a hat in the fields with a head like that.
barkeep/remark: Lovely. I can see the whole bar in that head.
dwarf/remark: Nothing on top? Grow a beard, friend. It balances out.
The forge takes the hair off eventually. Yours went early.
fremennik/insult: No hair to braid? What will the sagas say of you? Little.
A head like a Longhall table. Smooth, and seen some beer.
A bet in the Longhall, was it? The beer does not take hair. Usually.
burgher/insult: Lost your hair? We lost ours to worrying.
heartland/insult: The sun's bouncing right off your head, traveller.
heartland/remark: Mind you don't get sunburnt up top.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt has no hair. Good. Hair burn. TzHaar never had hair.
tzhaar/insult: Head smooth like cooled lava. Shame rest of JalYt still soft.
tzhaar/compliment: Smooth head, like good obsidian. JalYt almost handsome.
ogre/insult: Creature's head is like a egg. Hur, hur. Me likes eggs.
ogre/remark: Shiny head, creature. Not shiny enough to keep, though.
ogre/compliment: No hair on creature. Goodly. Hair gets in da stew.
gnome/compliment: A smooth head is very aerodynamic. Pilots would approve, human.
gnome/remark: Not a hair on top. Great Guthix, humans do things thoroughly.
dwarf/compliment: Bald as a polished ingot. Honest look, that.
dwarf/insult: Hair all gone and still no beard? Priorities, human.
fremennik/compliment: A bare head takes a helm better. Skulgrimen would agree.
No hair for an enemy to grab. That is a warrior's thinking.
fremennik/remark: A horned helm would sit well on that. Skulgrimen sells them.
moon_clan/compliment: A clear head, inside and out. The moon likes that in a person.
Nothing between your thoughts and the moon. How very convenient.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. Your thoughts are easier to read with nothing in the way.
Do not fret, dear. We can grow it back in a dream. It will not last.
moon_clan/remark: The moon is bald too, and nobody minds. Mostly nobody.
tortugan/compliment: Smooth as a good shell. A fine thing, where I come from.
Hair only slows you in the water. You have the right idea.
tortugan/insult: Hair is for land creatures. You seem to have given it up early.
A tortugan is born without hair. You had to work at it, I take it.
tortugan/remark: The hermit crabs would mistake that head for a shell. Mind them.
goblin/insult: Human head shiny like helmet. Wrong colour helmet.
goblin/remark: No hair on human. Goblins not got much hair neither. Is fine.
goblin/compliment: Bald head look strong. Like big rock. Me approve.
troll/insult: Human head smooth like river stone. Me try nibble it, maybe.
No hair on top. Less to pick out of troll teeth.
troll/remark: Bald head look like egg. Trolls like egg. Me not eat head. Probably.
troll/compliment: Shiny head like good rock. Me like rocks. Good head.
cat/remark: Fur gone off the top. Does it grow back? Mine does.
cat/insult: I've coughed up more hair than you've got on your head.
cat/compliment: Shiny head. Warm, I'd bet. Bend down, I'll check.
camel/remark: No hair on top. The sun will find that. It finds everything.
camel/insult: A bald head under this sun. You'll cook like a flatbread.
camel/compliment: A clean, smooth head. Rather elegant, like a dune.
leprechaun/remark: Not a hair on ye. Mebbe try a bit o' supercompost up top.
leprechaun/insult: Yer head's as bald as a fresh-raked patch, so it is.
leprechaun/compliment: A foine shiny head. Ye could see the weeds comin' in it.
mos_pirate/remark: Bald as a cannonball, ye be.
mos_pirate/insult: Sun'll have that head, landlubber. Get yerself a bandana.
mos_pirate/compliment: A fine head for a bandana, that.
moon_clan_wary/insult: A bare head. Your thoughts were easy to read already. Now easier.
Nothing between your thoughts and me. I wish there were.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Nothing to hide under, up there. Nothing to hide, either, I expect.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: A clear head. Keep it that way. I can see straight in.
guard/remark: Description: bald. Saves me a line of ink.
No helmet, no hair. At least I can see what you're thinking.
guard/insult: No hair. Easier to describe to the sergeant, I'll give you that.
guard/compliment: Nothing on your head to hide a weapon under. I like that.
barbarian/insult: Bald as a river stone. Nothing for a foe to grab. Or admire.
barbarian/remark: No hair? A helmet will fit you fine. Peksa's shop is just there.
barbarian/compliment: A bare head and no fear. That's a warrior's look, that.

item.pattern: ^(Rubber chicken|Bunny ears|Frog mask|Mime mask|Jester hat|Banana hat|Chicken head)

compliment: Love the {item}. Brightened my day, that.
Now the {item}, that's a proper look.
insult: What on earth is going on with the {item}?
Did you lose a bet? The {item}?
remark: I won't ask about the {item}.
Fancy dress party, is it?
kid/compliment: Haha! Look at the {item}!
kid/insult: Why have you got the {item} on? Are you poorly?
toff/insult: The {item}? How frightfully common.
pirate/compliment: Haha! A {item}! Ye'd fit right in below decks.

compliment: The {item}. Somebody's been at it for years, then.
The {item}! Proper dedication, that.
insult: Ah, the {item}. You'll want everyone to know, then.
Lovely {item}. Bit of a cardigan, mind.
remark: So you're the one who's good at that.
kid/compliment: Ooh, you're good at something!
rough/compliment: A {item}. Ye've put the hours in, then. Fair play.
dwarf/compliment: A {item}! A master. We masters must stick together.
heartland/remark: Wear that to the pub, do you?
tzhaar/compliment: Cape of a master. One thing done well. TzHaar-Hur understand.
tzhaar/remark: Cape means master, no? TzHaar born knowing. JalYt must learn.
tzhaar/insult: Fine cape. Does JalYt skill help in lava? No? Then is cape.
ogre/compliment: Nice cape. Yous good at sumfin. Is it cooking? Say cooking.
ogre/insult: Cape for being good at one fing. Ogre is good at all da smashing.
ogre/remark: Soft cape. Nice for wiping da chompy grease off. Hur, hur.
gnome/compliment: A {item}! You'd make a fine gnome, human. Apart from the size.
gnome/remark: A {item}, is it? The children will want a look.
dwarf/insult: A {item}. Fine. Smithing's the one that counts, mind.
dwarf/remark: The {item}. A master, then. Masters are welcome at my forge.
fremennik/compliment: A master's cape. One craft, done until it was yours. That is honour.
fremennik/remark: A {item}. One craft, a lifetime. The bards respect that, when sober.
moon_clan/compliment: The {item}. Years of one thought, held steady. Very few can.
moon_clan/insult: The {item}. Oh my. You are thinking of mentioning it. Do not.
tortugan/compliment: The {item}. Years of the same thing, done well. A tortugan's way.
tortugan/remark: The {item}. Leff would call it boring. Leff is young.
goblin/compliment: Human good at one thing. Goblins good at war. War best thing.
goblin/insult: Cape for being good at thing. Is thing fighting? No? Then not matter.
goblin/remark: Fancy cape. What colour is it? Not brown. Nothing is brown.
troll/compliment: Human good at one thing, cape say. Troll good at one thing. Eating.
troll/insult: Cape say human good at thing. Is thing cooking? No? Then not useful.
troll/remark: Fancy cape. Human wear cape, troll wear nothing. Troll warm anyway.
leprechaun/remark: A foine cape. Is it the farmin' one? Nay? Pity.
leprechaun/compliment: A cape for bein' good at a thing. Ye'd want the farmin' one, mind.
leprechaun/insult: Fancy cape. Can it hold a rake? Nay. Then I'm still needed.
moon_clan_wary/insult: The {item}. You are thinking of mentioning it. I would not.
Years at one craft. Hours of patience with us? Not one, I notice.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: The {item}. Patience, then. Perhaps you can learn to listen too.
guard/compliment: The {item}. The watch gives you a cloak. It leaks.
guard/remark: The {item}. A master, then. Masters still pay the toll.
guard/insult: Fancy cape. Doesn't exempt you from anything. I've checked.
barbarian/compliment: A cape for a skill. Is the skill swinging an axe? Then good.
barbarian/insult: A cape for one skill. If it's not fighting, I'm not impressed.
barbarian/remark: A master's cape. We don't give capes. We give scars.

compliment: Armour like that, you could walk through a wall. Slowly.
Proper armour, that. Respect.
insult: Bandos. Bit much for popping to the bank, isn't it?
Looks like you've been dipped in mustard.
remark: Bet that's a faff to get on and off.
The goblins would be ever so proud of you.
tzhaar/remark: Big brown armour of a war god. Heavy. JalYt carry it well enough.
tzhaar/compliment: Armour of the war god. JalYt took it from his army, no? Strong JalYt.
tzhaar/insult: War god armour. Big. Loud. JalYt inside still small.
ogre/compliment: Bandos armour! Da big war god's own. Creature wears it goodly.
ogre/insult: War god's armour on a creature. Grrr. Should be on an ogre.
ogre/remark: Ogre-ish armour, dat. Big and brown. Creature nearly looks right.
gnome/compliment: Armour from the god of war himself. Great Guthix, human, you're brave.
gnome/insult: Bandos armour. You'd sink a glider, human. Walk, please.
dwarf/compliment: Bandos plate. Thick as a mine cart and twice as proud. Good.
dwarf/insult: Bandos. Mustard-coloured. The Yellow Fortune would want a word.
dwarf/remark: Armour from the God Wars. Older than the Consortium, and still sound.
fremennik/compliment: Armour off a war god's soldier. The bards will want the details.
fremennik/insult: A war god's armour. It fits like it was made for someone bigger.
moon_clan/compliment: A war god's armour, and a quiet mind inside it. Interesting.
moon_clan/insult: A war god's armour. Oh my. It is louder than your thoughts.
tortugan/compliment: Heavy armour, worn calmly. A shell is heavy too. One gets used to it.
tortugan/remark: A war god's armour. At sea, the sea is the only war we know.
goblin/compliment: Armour of Big High War God! Human wear it? Praise Big High War God!
Big High War God armour! Human must be mighty. Or sneaky. Both good.
goblin/insult: Armour of Big High War God on human? Human not even goblin. Wrong!
goblin/remark: Big brown armour. Brown! Generals both say brown best. Human listen.
troll/compliment: Big brown armour. Heavy like rock. Human strong like troll, nearly.
troll/insult: Big heavy armour. Human walk like troll now. Still not troll.
troll/remark: Dat armour big. Human inside small. Like nut in big shell.
barbarian/compliment: Heavy brown plate, and you carry it like nothing. Good.
barbarian/insult: Armour of the goblins' war god? On you? Hah!
barbarian/remark: Big war plate. It was the goblins' god's, they say. Yours now.

compliment: Feathers and gold. You look like a very expensive bird.
Winged armour. You look like you might take off. Don't.
insult: Bit heavy on the gold trim, if I'm honest.
You look like a posh curtain.
remark: Don't stand near any magpies.
goblin/insult: Bird armour. Feathers. Human want fly away from battle? Cowards!
goblin/remark: Feathery armour. Bird god. Goblins not fight for bird god.
goblin/compliment: Shiny feather armour. Human look like big expensive bird. Tasty bird.

compliment: A Santa hat! Merry Christmas, traveller.
Very festive. Lovely.
insult: It's not Christmas. Is it? Nobody tells me anything.
kid/compliment: Are you Father Christmas?!
kid/insult: Santa's not real. My brother said.
heartland/remark: Christmas, is it? Nobody's told the goose.

compliment: By the look of that cape, you've helped everyone in Gielinor.
That cape means you've run every errand going. Respect.
insult: So you're the one who keeps poking about in everyone's sheds.
remark: You must have heard some strange requests in your time.
tzhaar/compliment: Cape for finishing every errand. JalYt who finish. Rare JalYt.
tzhaar/remark: Many deeds in that cape. JalYt carry stories like TzHaar carry memory.
tzhaar/insult: Cape for helping everyone. Everyone up top. Down here, is just cape.
ogre/compliment: Dat cape means creature helps everybody. Help ogre. Bring chompy.
ogre/insult: Creature does jobs for everybody? Stoopid. Ogre does jobs for ogre.
ogre/remark: Fancy cape for running errands. Ogres don't run. Ogres sit.
gnome/compliment: That cape! You've helped half of Gielinor, human. Narnode included?
gnome/insult: A cape for doing errands. Humans will wear anything, Great Guthix.
gnome/remark: Every errand in the land, they say. You must know every glider route.
dwarf/compliment: Helped everyone from here to Keldagrim, that cape says. By Guthix.
dwarf/insult: A cape for running errands. I'd rather have one for smithing.
fremennik/compliment: A cape for finishing every task. Sigmund's errands alone break most.
fremennik/insult: A cape for errands. Sigmund has you fetching flowers, I expect.
moon_clan/compliment: A cape for helping everyone. Your thoughts are tidy for one so busy.
moon_clan/remark: That cape says you have been everywhere. Your dreams must be crowded.
tortugan/compliment: Helped everyone, that cape says. Few tourists stay long enough.
tortugan/insult: Everyone's errands done. Humans do love to be busy.
moon_clan_wary/insult: A cape for meddling everywhere. Now you have come to meddle with us.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Been everywhere, that cape says. Nowhere taught you to listen.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: A cape for helping everyone. We did not ask. Still. It is something.

compliment: Still standing. That's the spirit.
insult: You look like death warmed up.
Bit peaky, aren't you?
remark: You're looking a bit worse for wear, traveller.
Go and have a sit down. And a cup of tea.
You've been in the wars, haven't you?
kid/remark: Are you going to die?
nan/remark: Ooh, you've been in the wars. Sit down before you fall down.
vicar/remark: You look in need of healing. Or a decent night's sleep.
barkeep/remark: You look like you've been through the sewers. Sit by the door.
gnome/remark: You look like you lost at gnomeball. Badly. Have a toad crunchie.
You need a cocktail and a lie down. In that order, human.
pirate/remark: Ye look half drowned. Rum first, questions after.
rough/remark: Cor, ye've been in the wars. Sit on that bale before ye fall.
barkeep/insult: Don't bleed on the bar. I've only just wiped it.
dwarf/remark: You look like a cracked anvil. Sit down before you split.
Sit down before you fall down, human. There's a stout in it.
fremennik/compliment: Wounded and still walking. Hah! There's Fremennik in you yet.
Bleeding, and your back is still straight. The spirits note that.
Hah! Wounds are a saga written on the skin. Yours has a chapter.
burgher/remark: You look pale. Pale's bad round here. Get indoors.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt look cold. Cold JalYt soon dead JalYt. Go sit by lava.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt leaking again. Red water this time. Is worse, no?
tzhaar/compliment: Hurt, still standing. TzHaar-Ket would nod at that. Once.
ogre/remark: Creature looks half dead. Half dead is half cooked, me finks.
ogre/insult: Grrr, creature is leaking. Don't drip on da rock cakes.
ogre/compliment: Still walking wiv all dat leaking? Tough creature. Chewy, too.
gnome/compliment: Still upright, human! A gnome would be flat by now.
gnome/insult: Did a glider land on you? You look like a glider landed on you.
dwarf/compliment: Battered, but still standing. Good metal does the same.
dwarf/insult: You look like a pie that's been dropped. Twice.
fremennik/insult: You look like something a dagannoth spat out. Half chewed, at that.
Sit down before you fall down. Falling down is for the Longhall.
fremennik/remark: A warrior's wounds are an honour. Still, go and sit by a fire.
moon_clan/compliment: Hurt, but your thoughts are steady. That is the harder part.
Still standing, with all that pain. The mind is the stronger part.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. I can hear your head throbbing from here, dear. Do sit.
Try to think less loudly about the pain. Some of us are listening.
moon_clan/remark: Rest, dear. The body knits itself best while the mind is dreaming.
tortugan/compliment: Wounded and still patient. You would make a decent tortugan.
You carry that hurt quietly. Very well. That is the right way.
tortugan/insult: You look like a gryphon's leftovers. They rarely leave any.
No shell to hide in, and it shows. Do find somewhere to sit.
tortugan/remark: Salt water would do that good. Or sting. One of the two.
goblin/remark: Human leaking. Humans leak lots when hit. Goblins too, but quieter.
goblin/insult: Human half dead! Not show mercy, commandment say. Me show little bit.
goblin/compliment: Human hurt but not run from battle. Big High War God like that.
troll/remark: Human leaking. Humans leak when hit. Trolls heal quick, humans not.
troll/insult: Human look half cooked already. Burntmeat like dat. Me just hungry.
troll/compliment: Hurt but still standing. Tough human. Tough meat, though.
cat/remark: You smell of blood. Yours, I think. Humans leak so.
cat/insult: You look like something I'd bring in and leave on the step.
cat/compliment: Still on your feet. I'd have had a nap by now.
camel/remark: You look dry and wounded. I know the feeling, every day.
camel/insult: You sway like a tent in the wind. Sit down before you fall on me.
camel/compliment: Hurt, and still walking. The desert respects that. So do I.
leprechaun/remark: Ye look like a patch wi' the disease on it, so ye do.
leprechaun/insult: 'Tis plant cure ye need. Nay, I've none for people.
leprechaun/compliment: Still standin', and ye lookin' like that? Foine stuff.
parrot/insult: Squawk! Dead men tell no tales!
mos_pirate/insult: Dead men tell no tales, and ye be lookin' like one.
mos_pirate/compliment: Still on yer feet? Tough as old rope, ye be.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Hurt, and thinking about it very loudly. Do it elsewhere.
You are in pain. I know. I can hear it. Keep it to yourself.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Bleeding on our doorstep will not earn you anything.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Wounded, and still upright. Strong in body. We went the other way.
guard/remark: You're bleeding on the paving. Someone will have to mop that.
You look half dead. Don't finish the job on my patch.
guard/insult: If you're going to fall over, do it outside the walls.
guard/compliment: Walked in that state and still upright. Fair enough.
barbarian/remark: You're hurt. Good. Means you've been fighting, not talking.
barbarian/insult: Bleeding already? Bah! Walk it off, little one.
barbarian/compliment: Wounded and still on your feet. The longhall would drink to that.

compliment: That armour's seen a few centuries, by the look of it. Very grand.
Lovely old armour, that. They don't make it like that any more.
insult: You dug that gear out of a grave, didn't you?
That armour smells a bit of crypt.
remark: Been rummaging in tombs again?
Some poor brother's missing that.
trader/remark: Grave goods, those. I don't ask. I just value.
pirate/remark: That armour's off a dead man. Arr, so were me boots.
barkeep/insult: You've brought the crypt in with you. Sit by the window.
dwarf/remark: Old work, that. Good work, mind. They cared, back then.
fremennik/remark: Grave iron. The spirits don't care for that, outerlander.
tzhaar/remark: That armour from graves of JalYt. TzHaar dead become rock. Cleaner.
tzhaar/insult: Grave armour. JalYt dig up own dead? TzHaar keep ours as statues.
tzhaar/compliment: Old armour, still strong. Has memories in it. TzHaar understand that.
ogre/insult: Creature smells like a zogrie. Grrr. Stay away from da village.
ogre/remark: Dead man's armour. Dead man didn't need it. Fair, me suppose.
ogre/compliment: Old crypt armour. Creature dug it up? Ogre likes a creature what digs.
gnome/compliment: Old armour, that. Older than the Grand Tree, maybe. Impressive, human.
gnome/insult: You smell of tomb, human. Kar, don't sit by the cocktail bar.
gnome/remark: Grave armour. Humans dig up the oddest things.
dwarf/compliment: Crypt work, but good crypt work. The smiths of old knew their trade.
dwarf/insult: Dug that out of a barrow? Give it a scrub before the forge sees it.
fremennik/compliment: Armour from the dead. You took it from a dead man's hands. Bold.
fremennik/insult: Grave iron. A warrior wins gear. He does not dig for it.
moon_clan/compliment: That armour has dreamt a long time. It is glad to be awake.
moon_clan/remark: Oh my. That armour is still thinking about its old owner. So is he.
tortugan/compliment: Old armour, well kept. Age is no shame. Ask any elder.
tortugan/insult: Dug up, was it? We weave baskets for our dead. We do not rob them.
goblin/remark: Human dig up old armour from graves. Goblins just take from crates.
goblin/insult: Old mouldy armour. Smell like worm stew left out. Me quite like it.
goblin/compliment: Old armour from tomb. Goblins fight in old armour too. Strong stuff.
troll/compliment: Old armour from graves. Smell like old troll cave. Me like.
troll/insult: Dug up dead human's clothes? Trolls not even do dat. Trolls eat fresh.
troll/remark: Mouldy armour. Smell like goat left out too long. Me still eat goat.
guard/remark: That armour came out of a grave. Grave-robbing's a crime. Somewhere.
guard/insult: Tomb armour in the street. If it's got a smell, keep upwind of me.
guard/compliment: Old armour. Looks like it's seen things. So have I. Mostly carts.
barbarian/compliment: Dug that out of a grave? Hah! A warrior keeps what he wins.
barbarian/insult: Grave armour. Smells like it too. Stand downwind.
barbarian/remark: Old armour from the swamp tombs. The dead don't need it. Fair.

compliment: That's a castle's worth of armour you're wearing. Blimey.
Look at you, done up like a duke.
insult: All that money on your back, and still no manners.
sharp/insult: Money can't buy taste. You've proved it.
remark: Mind the pickpockets. They'll smell that money.
banker/remark: We do offer secure storage. You'd want the big vault.
trader/compliment: A customer of quality! Come in, come in. Mind the cheap stuff.
shady/remark: Lot of money walking about on one person. Careless.
guard/insult: Oi. All that steel's for outside the walls, understand?
All that gold. I'll be watching you, and so will worse than me.
gnome/compliment: Human, you glitter like a spirit tree at midsummer. Splendid.
Rometti would sell his shop for that outfit, human.
gnome/remark: A gnome could retire on one of your boots, human.
pirate/compliment: Arr, ye're wearing a galleon's worth. Mind the press gangs.
pirate/remark: Shiny as a captain's chest, ye are. Don't walk the docks alone.
rough/insult: All that gold, and ye've never lifted a hoe, I'll wager.
rough/remark: Blimey. That lot'd buy my farm twice over.
barkeep/compliment: Done up like that, you're buying. Them's the rules.
barkeep/remark: Mind the step. Wouldn't want all that gold going over.
dwarf/compliment: Good steel, well kept. Someone forged that with love.
dwarf/remark: That's a year at the anvil you're wearing, friend.
The Consortium would make you a director on the spot, dressed so.
fremennik/compliment: A longhall's worth of gold on your back, and you still stand straight.
Trophies, or bought? Either way, you carry them like a chieftain.
Hah! Enough on your back to buy the Longhall a year of beer.
fremennik/insult: Gold on your back, outerlander. Gold wins no sagas.
All that gold, and I wager you have never hauled a net.
A dagannoth does not care what your armour cost. Nor do I.
guard/remark: Full plate on market day. I'll be two paces behind you.
guard/compliment: Armour like that, you could join the watch. We pay in soup.
burgher/compliment: All that shiny stuff. Never seen so much shiny.
burgher/remark: Don't wave that about here. Folk is hungry.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt wears much gold. Gold is soft. Will melt down here.
tzhaar/insult: All that soft gold on one JalYt. TokKul worth more. Hard money.
tzhaar/compliment: Fine gear for a JalYt. Someone paid many TokKul for that, no?
ogre/compliment: Ooh, creature all bright pretties! Bestest fing me seen today.
ogre/insult: All dem shiny bits, creature. Dey come off before cooking, yes?
ogre/remark: Creature is walking treasure. Ogres notice. Ogres always notice.
gnome/insult: All that finery, and you still can't fit in a glider.
dwarf/insult: Fine gear, human. Bought, I'd say, not earned at an anvil.
fremennik/remark: Sigmund the Merchant would follow you home for that. Politely.
moon_clan/compliment: All that finery, and no greed in your thoughts. How unusual, dear.
Riches outside, riches within. One does not always find both.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. All that gold, and your thoughts are still rather small.
You are thinking about how much it is worth. Rather loudly, dear.
moon_clan/remark: We trade little for gold on the island. Magic is cheaper, and lighter.
tortugan/compliment: A fine shell you have built yourself. Heavy, but fine.
All that is earned, I take it. Patience pays well, in the end.
tortugan/insult: Gold does not float. Mind where you fall in.
A tortugan carries one shell. You seem to have bought several.
tortugan/remark: At sea, that much metal is ballast. On land, I gather it is fashion.
goblin/compliment: Shiny armour everywhere! Human must be bigger than general.
goblin/insult: All that shiny stuff and human still ugly. Shiny not help face.
goblin/remark: Human wear lots of expensive. Goblins wear goblin mail. Brown now.
troll/compliment: Lotta shiny stuff on human. Human must be big boss, like troll boss.
troll/insult: All dat metal. Troll crack it open like nut. Human is nut inside.
troll/remark: Shiny human. Too much tin. Trolls not eat tin. Bad for teeth.
cat/remark: All that shiny metal. Does it come off? Can I sit in it?
cat/insult: Dressed like a king, and still no fish on you. Priorities.
cat/compliment: Shiny. Warm when the sun's on it, I expect. I may sit on you.
camel/remark: All that metal in this heat. You could roast an egg on you.
camel/insult: Dressed like an emir, and still you smell of goat.
camel/compliment: Finery like that deserves a sonnet. I'll start one tonight.
leprechaun/remark: All that shiny gear, and I'll wager ye've still no rake.
leprechaun/insult: Ye could buy the whole farm, and ye'd still not weed it.
leprechaun/compliment: Foine armour, that. Don't ye be muckin' it up in me compost.
parrot/compliment: Squawk! Rich as a captain! Rich as a captain!
mos_pirate/remark: Arr, there be plunder walkin' about on two legs.
mos_pirate/insult: Flash as a captain, and ye still walk like a landlubber.
mos_pirate/compliment: That be a fine haul ye're wearin', and no mistake.
moon_clan_wary/insult: All that gold, and still you came picking at our secrets.
You are thinking about what it is all worth. Loudly. How mainland.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Gold buys nothing from us. Patience might. You brought the wrong one.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Wealthy, and not thinking about it. Unusual, for a mainlander.
barbarian/insult: All that shiny metal. Did you win it, or buy it? Buy it, I bet.
barbarian/remark: Rich, are you? Then you're buying in the longhall tonight.
barbarian/compliment: Armour like that gets taken off the beaten. Hah! Well taken.

compliment: Mix and match. Very individual.
insult: Did you get dressed in the dark?
A bit of everything there. Like a jumble sale.
plain/insult: Bit of a dog's dinner, that outfit.
remark: Matching's overrated, I suppose.
A scrap merchant would love you.
kid/insult: Your armour doesn't match. That's not allowed.
toff/insult: Nothing matches. Nothing. One feels quite unwell.
dwarf/insult: Five smiths made that outfit, and none of them spoke to each other.
gnome/remark: Rometti would weep at that outfit, human. Quietly, but he'd weep.
pirate/insult: Dressed from six different shipwrecks, by the look of ye.
barkeep/insult: Rough night? You've come out in someone else's armour.
fremennik/insult: Did you loot that armour from three different dead men, outerlander?
burgher/insult: Your armour don't match. Even our rags match.
tzhaar/insult: Many metals, none match. JalYt dressed by many silly JalYt.
tzhaar/remark: Bits of this, bits of that. TzHaar-Hur use one rock. Is simpler.
tzhaar/compliment: Odd armour, JalYt. But all of it hard. TzHaar approve of hard.
ogre/insult: Creature is wearing bits of everyfing. Like a stew. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Dat armour is all different colours. Confuses da chompies, maybe.
ogre/compliment: All different shiny bits! Creature got lots of pretties. Goodly.
gnome/compliment: Every colour at once. Very cheerful, human. Like a cocktail.
gnome/insult: Did you dress by falling through a smithy, human?
dwarf/compliment: Mixed metals, but each piece well made. I'll give you that.
dwarf/remark: Bronze, iron and steel all at once. Make your mind up, human.
goblin/insult: Human armour all different colours! Pick one! Even generals pick one.
Bits of this colour, bits of that. Human start own armour argument.
goblin/remark: Mixed up armour. Grubfoot wear red and green at once. Lonely now.
goblin/compliment: Many colour armour. Clever. Nobody can say human pick wrong colour.
troll/insult: Bits of all metals. Human pick one! Even trolls pick one rock.
Human armour all different. Like Lalli's stew. All sorts chucked in.
troll/remark: Human armour all different. Like rocks in a pile. Me like piles.
troll/compliment: Many metals. Clever. Troll teeth not know which bit hurt first.
guard/insult: Half of that kit's not yours, is it? I'm asking officially.
Armour from four different smiths. Or four different victims.
guard/remark: Three metals, one adventurer. Where did the rest come from?
barbarian/insult: Armour from three different smiths? Pick one and fight in it.
barbarian/remark: Mismatched plate. Stripped off whoever you beat, I'd guess.
barbarian/compliment: Odd bits of armour, all won in fights, I'd wager. Good.

compliment: Pest Control gear. Those knights don't hand that out for nothing.
insult: Void robes. You look like a very serious sack.
Is that fancy dress? Very convincing.
remark: Those Pest Control knights still bossing you about?
kid/insult: You look like a bucket with legs.

compliment: Bronze polishes up nicely, that. Somebody's been at it with a rag.
Bronze. Honest stuff, that.
insult: Head to toe in bronze. The goblins will be envious. The goblins.
Is that bronze, or have you gone rusty?
plain/insult: Off to fight the chickens, are we?
kid/insult: My sword's better than yours, and it's a stick.
dwarf/insult: Bronze! My grandmother wouldn't make a spoon out of it.
rough/remark: Bronze, eh? I've a pitchfork with more edge.
dwarf/compliment: Bronze. Everyone's first metal. I still have my first spoon.
heartland/remark: The tutor hand that out, did he? Generous with the bronze.
tzhaar/insult: Bronze. Soft metal. JalYt wear it like it means something.
tzhaar/remark: Bronze armour. Would melt by lava. Stand back a bit, JalYt.
tzhaar/compliment: Bronze is poor rock, but JalYt wear it with straight back. Good.
ogre/insult: Bronze bits. Ogre bites through bronze. Hur, hur. Nice crunchy.
ogre/remark: Not very shiny, dat. Brown shiny. Is da worst shiny.
ogre/compliment: Shiny-ish bronze. Goodly start, creature. Get more shiny later.
gnome/compliment: Bronze, human! Shiny. The children would love it.
gnome/insult: Bronze armour. Slow and heavy. Very human, that.
gnome/remark: Bronze armour. You'd sink a glider in that, human.
dwarf/remark: Bronze. Copper and tin, a bit of hope. We all started there.
fremennik/compliment: Bronze, worn without shame. A warrior starts somewhere. Keep going.
fremennik/insult: Bronze. A rock crab would laugh, if rock crabs laughed.
moon_clan/compliment: Bronze, and no shame in your thoughts about it. Good.
moon_clan/insult: Bronze. We would use magic. But you make do, I suppose.
tortugan/compliment: Bronze is a start. A juvenile's first shell is soft too.
tortugan/remark: Bronze turns green in salt water. Rather like coral, only sadder.
goblin/insult: Bronze armour. Brown-ish. Nearly goblin colour. Nearly good.
Bronze, human? Goblin mail better. And it brown. Proper brown.
goblin/remark: Bronze is brown colour. Wartface would wear that. Bentnoze not.
goblin/compliment: Brown-ish armour! Good colour. Dark earthy colour, like goblin.
troll/insult: Bronze armour. Soft tin. Troll teeth go straight through. Nice, dat.
troll/remark: Bronze. Brown like burnt meat. Me like burnt meat.
troll/compliment: Bronze shine like pretty rock. Me like pretty rocks.
guard/insult: Bronze, head to toe. I'll not be needing a second man for you.
guard/remark: Bronze. The watch issues better than that, and we're issued nothing.
guard/compliment: Bronze armour. Harmless. I like harmless.
barbarian/insult: Bronze! Hah! Peksa sells better in his sleep.
barbarian/remark: Bronze armour. Our young ones start in that. Then they grow.
barbarian/compliment: Bronze, but worn with a straight back. It's a start.

compliment: Looking very light on your feet today.
insult: Running clothes. Running from what, exactly?
Dressed for a run, and still walking. Interesting.
remark: Running the rooftops again, are we?
kid/insult: You run on roofs? Mum says that's not allowed.
gnome/compliment: Light on your feet, for a human. Our agility course would suit you.
Graceful! Now you move like a gnome, human. Nearly.
rough/insult: Dressed for running, eh? Try running a farm.
heartland/compliment: Light on your feet, you. Barely heard you coming.
heartland/remark: Mind the washing lines up there.
tzhaar/remark: Light clothes. JalYt run on roofs, they say. No roofs down here.
tzhaar/insult: Running clothes. Running from what? Lava does not chase.
tzhaar/compliment: Quick JalYt. TzHaar-Xil are swift too. Race them. Lose, but race.
ogre/insult: Soft running clothes. Creature runs from ogres? Everybody does.
ogre/remark: Creature dressed for running. Chompies run too. Den dey get stuck.
ogre/compliment: Fast creature! Catch da chompies for ogre. Ogre too big to chase.
gnome/insult: Running clothes on a human. The agility course will still beat you.
gnome/remark: Rooftop runner? Our course has nets and ropes. Very good for humans.
dwarf/compliment: Light clothes for a light step. Not for me, but well made.
dwarf/insult: No armour, just running clothes. Running from the smithing, I expect.
dwarf/remark: Graceful. Fine for rooftops. No good in a mine cart.
fremennik/compliment: Light clothes for running. Swensen's maze would suit you, then.
fremennik/insult: Running clothes. A Fremennik runs toward the fight, not from it.
moon_clan/compliment: Dressed for running. Your thoughts are swift too. I barely keep up.
moon_clan/remark: Running clothes. On the island we simply think ourselves elsewhere.
tortugan/compliment: Light clothes, light step. Like swimming, on land.
tortugan/insult: Clothes for running. Where to, human? It will still be there.
goblin/insult: Running clothes. Running from battle? Cowards must die, priest say.
goblin/remark: Light clothes for running. Goblins not run. Goblins stand and shout.
goblin/compliment: Fast human. Run fast at enemies, me hope. Not away.
troll/insult: Running clothes. Human run from trolls? Rocks faster than human.
troll/remark: Light clothes for running. Trolls not run. Trolls chuck.
troll/compliment: Fast human. Run fast up mountain. Dat is good. Goats do it too.
leprechaun/remark: Runnin' clothes. Runnin' between patches, I hope.
leprechaun/insult: Ye'll run yer legs off and still miss the waterin', so ye will.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Dressed for running away. Sensible, around us.
Running clothes. Rushing about is a mainland habit. We think first.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Dressed for running. You will not outrun a thought.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Light on your feet. Quiet, almost. Almost.
guard/insult: Rooftop clothes. Rooftops are not a thoroughfare. Get down.
I know those clothes. Off the roofs. There's a perfectly good road.
guard/remark: Running kit. Where to, and why, and does it involve my gate?
barbarian/insult: Running clothes? We don't run. We scream and charge.
barbarian/remark: Light clothes for running. Run at things, I hope.
barbarian/compliment: Quick on your feet, eh? Good. Then charge faster.

compliment: A whip from the Abyss. Half the kingdom's got one. The better half.
insult: That whip's from the Abyss? Keep it away from the washing.
Do keep that thing coiled indoors.
remark: Mind where you swing that thing.
tzhaar/remark: Whip from the Abyss. Floppy weapon. Obsidian does not flop.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt fight with a rope. TzHaar fight with rock. Rock wins.
tzhaar/compliment: Whip looks fast. TzHaar-Xil like fast. JalYt-Xil, maybe.
ogre/compliment: Whippy fing! Ogre likes da whippy fing. Hit da chompies wiv it.
ogre/insult: Creature fights wiv a bit of rope? Ogres fight wiv da whole tree.
ogre/remark: Dat whip looks alive. Does it bite? Keep it off da stew.
gnome/compliment: A whip from the Abyss! Quick hands, human. Nearly gnome-quick.
gnome/remark: Keep that whip coiled, human. The squirrels get nervous.
dwarf/insult: A whip? No weight, no edge. Where's the metal, human?
dwarf/remark: Not a smith's work, that. Came off a demon, they say.
fremennik/compliment: A whip from the Abyss. Strange weapon. You swing it like you mean it.
fremennik/insult: A whip. Hah! A Fremennik carries an axe. A whip is for the yaks.
moon_clan/compliment: A whip from the Abyss. It hums, rather. Your mind hums back.
moon_clan/remark: Oh my. Something from the Abyss, dear. Keep it away from the dreams.
tortugan/compliment: A whip. Quick, and quiet. Very well. The sea respects quick.
tortugan/insult: A whip from the Abyss. Humans do need a tool for everything.
goblin/remark: Whippy thing. Not warhammer, not battleaxe. Generals not like that.
goblin/insult: Human fight with rope? Goblins fight with big lump of iron.
goblin/compliment: Whip look fast. Hit many times. Big High War God like many hits.
troll/insult: Big whip thing. Dat get stuck in troll throat. Human cheat.
troll/remark: Whippy thing. Not rock. Trolls not trust weapon you can't chuck.
troll/compliment: Whip look fast. Hit many times. Troll skin thick, though. Try.
barbarian/remark: Not a sword, not an axe. What is that, a rope?
barbarian/insult: You fight with a whip? Ho ho! Try it on Gunthor.
barbarian/compliment: A whip. Odd weapon. Fast, though. Fast is good.

compliment: A slayer helmet. The monsters must see that coming and sigh.
insult: Is that a helmet, or did something eat your head and stay?
Looks like your head got stuck in a bucket.
remark: Off to kill something horrible, I expect.
kid/insult: Your helmet's got a face on it. Why's it got a face?
slayer_master/compliment: A proper slayer's helm. You've earned that, I'll grant.
tzhaar/remark: Helmet with a face. JalYt hunt monsters, no? TzHaar-Xil would nod.
tzhaar/compliment: Hunter's helmet. Ugly, useful. TzHaar-Xil wear worse.
tzhaar/insult: Helmet has face on it. Face is better than JalYt face. Keep it on.
ogre/insult: Helmet wiv a face! Hur, hur. Face is uglier dan a ogre. Nearly.
ogre/remark: Creature kills monsters for a living? Ogre kills monsters for dinner.
ogre/compliment: Scary face helmet. Goodly. Chompies would fly off. Keep it away.
gnome/compliment: That helmet! The children think you're a monster. They're thrilled.
gnome/insult: That helmet looks heavier than a gnome, human. It probably is.
dwarf/compliment: A slayer helmet. Ugly as sin, but well put together. Fair play.
dwarf/remark: That helmet's a dozen things stuck together. It works, mind.

compliment: You look like you could handle yourself.
I'll not argue with you, then.
insult: You look strong enough. Shame about the dress sense.
remark: Don't start any trouble round here, will you?
gnome/compliment: You could carry a glider on your back, human. Don't, but you could.
pirate/compliment: Arr, ye'd do for a bosun. Can ye swim, though?
rough/remark: Ye look handy. Fancy a day's work hauling nets?
dwarf/compliment: You've the shoulders for the forge. Shame to waste them fighting.
fremennik/compliment: You've a warrior's arm. Come to the longhall, we'll test it.
Hah! You carry yourself like one who has killed a dagannoth. Or two.
Sigli would want you on the hunt. That is not said lightly.
tzhaar/compliment: Strong JalYt. Fight Cave would like you. Maybe you like it back.
JalYt has fighter look. TzHaar-Ket would test that. Gladly.
tzhaar/insult: Big strong JalYt. Still soft inside. TzHaar can tell.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt fight much, no? TzHaar-Ket watch you. Is respect, mostly.
ogre/compliment: Big strong creature. Grrr. Me not try eating dat one. Yet.
ogre/insult: Creature finks it is biggun. Ogre is bigger. Ogre is always bigger.
ogre/remark: Dat creature hits fings, me can tell. Good at hitting is goodly.
gnome/insult: Strong enough, human. We'd still beat you at gnomeball.
gnome/remark: The children want to know if you fight ogres, human.
dwarf/insult: All that muscle and I bet you've never swung a hammer.
dwarf/remark: You'd not last a day down a mine, mind. Different sort of strong.
fremennik/insult: Strong, yes. But can you hold a keg down? Manni will want to know.
A strong arm. Now let us see if there is a strong stomach to match.
fremennik/remark: The bards sing of arms like that. Mostly they sing badly.
moon_clan/compliment: Strong in body. If the mind matches, you will do very well.
You could be Fremennik, with that build. Luckily, you think.
moon_clan/insult: Strong in body, dear. The Fremennik are, too. It is not a boast.
Very strong, yes. I am reading your mind for what else. One moment.
moon_clan/remark: The Fremennik grew strong in body. You seem to have taken that road.
tortugan/compliment: You would do well against a gryphon. From a tortugan, that is praise.
Strong, and not in a hurry about it. Rare in a human.
tortugan/insult: Very strong on land. The sea does not hold land in much regard.
Strong, yes. A gryphon is stronger, and it still waits for its moment.
tortugan/remark: A tortugan proves itself in the Trial by Water. You found your own.
goblin/compliment: Big strong human. Nearly goblin strong. Big High War God notice you.
goblin/insult: Human look strong. Still not goblin. Goblins most powerful race!
goblin/remark: Human fight lots, me can tell. War good. Human maybe not stupid.
troll/compliment: Big strong human. Nearly troll strong. Nearly.
Human fight good, me can tell. Me not fight you. Me busy. Very busy.
troll/insult: Strong human. Still got little bendy neck, like all humans.
troll/remark: Human look like fighter. Trolls chuck rocks at fighters. From far.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Strong in body. We grew strong in mind. One of us chose well.
Built like a Fremennik. Thinking like one too, I expect.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Strength of arm. That is how the Fremennik settle things. Not us.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: A strong arm. Fine. Now show me a strong mind. I am waiting.
guard/compliment: You could handle yourself, I'd say. Please don't, inside the walls.
guard/insult: Someone built like you gets a watchman each. You've got me.
guard/remark: Seen a few of your sort. The walls are still standing. Mostly.
If there's a fight in town tonight, I'll know where to look.
barbarian/compliment: You carry yourself like a warrior. Gunthor would want a word.
barbarian/insult: Strong, are you? Hah! Our young ones say that too. Wanna fight?
barbarian/remark: There's a fighter under all that. The longhall's that way.

compliment: Doesn't matter what you wear. It's what's inside.
insult: Did the goblins dress you? They've better taste.
That whole outfit wouldn't buy a pie.
remark: Times are hard, I know.
banker/remark: We'd be happy to open an account. Small accounts welcome.
kid/insult: Are you poor? You look poor.
gnome/compliment: Gnomes judge by deeds, not boots. Your boots are grateful.
pirate/insult: Arr, ye've been keelhauled, by the look of yer clothes.
rough/insult: Ye look like something I pulled out of the ditch.
barkeep/insult: You've the look of someone who asks about a tab. No.
dwarf/compliment: Poor gear, good heart. I can fix the first.
fremennik/compliment: Rags or riches, the spirits judge the arm, not the cloth.
Poor gear, straight back. We began with less, and built Rellekka.
Hah! Hide and nerve is all a Fremennik needs. You have the nerve.
heartland/remark: There's always farm work going, if you need it.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt gear worth no TokKul. Not even one. TzHaar checked.
tzhaar/remark: Poor JalYt. Gold is soft anyway. You lose nothing much.
tzhaar/compliment: Poor JalYt still come down here. Is heart, not TokKul. Good.
ogre/insult: Creature got no pretties at all? Not even worth robbing. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Skinny poor creature. Not much meat, not much shiny. Not worth da pot.
ogre/compliment: No pretties, creature? Is fine. Ogres only want da chompies.
gnome/insult: Kar, I shan't lend you a glider. You'd sell it, by the look of you.
gnome/remark: Short of coin, human? Blurberry always needs someone to wash glasses.
dwarf/insult: That gear wouldn't fetch a pie in Keldagrim. Half a pie.
dwarf/remark: Gold's the answer, human. Always is. Go and dig some.
fremennik/insult: Did the trolls take your gear, or did you never have any?
That gear was not won. It was not even bought, by the look of it.
fremennik/remark: Skulgrimen sells gear. Not to everyone, mind.
moon_clan/compliment: Poor in purse, rich in thought. I would not trade, dear.
You own little, and want less. There is wisdom in that.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. The thoughts are tidy, at least. The clothes less so.
Do not worry, dear. We can dress you in a dream. Only in a dream.
moon_clan/remark: On the island we would mend that by magic. Or wear it anyway.
tortugan/compliment: Little gear, no fuss. That is the sea's way, and ours.
You travel light. Tourists usually bring far too much.
tortugan/insult: Even the hermit crabs find a better shell than that, human.
A juvenile would give up a shell that poor. Very well. Carry on.
tortugan/remark: The sea provides, in time. Patience is cheaper than a shop.
goblin/insult: Human armour worse than goblin mail. Goblin mail at least brown.
goblin/remark: Human got nothing shiny. Nothing for Wormbrain to pick up, then.
goblin/compliment: Poor human still come fight. Not run from battle. Me respect that bit.
troll/insult: Human got nothing shiny. Not even tin. Just meat.
Poor human. Even Lalli got golden apples. Human got rags.
troll/remark: Rags on human. No peeling needed. Handy, dat.
troll/compliment: Poor human still come up mountain. Brave. Or hungry. Me know hungry.
cat/remark: Dressed in rags. A cat toy, the whole outfit.
cat/insult: Even the rats dress better, and they live in a sewer.
cat/compliment: No fuss, no finery. Very cat. I approve, quietly.
camel/remark: Rags and string. The sand will have those by nightfall.
camel/insult: I've seen better dressed goats, and the goats weren't trying.
camel/compliment: Plain cloth and no airs. The desert likes an honest traveller.
leprechaun/remark: Dressed like a scarecrow, ye are. Mebbe the crows'll not mind.
leprechaun/insult: Nay, I'll not swap that lot for banknotes. Nobody would.
leprechaun/compliment: Plain clothes for honest work. Nothin' wrong wi' that at all.
parrot/remark: Squawk! Scrapin' the barrel! Scrapin' the barrel!
parrot/insult: Squawk! Rags! None of yer rags!
mos_pirate/remark: Scrapin' the barrel, that rig be.
mos_pirate/insult: None of yer rags here, landlubber. Mike wouldn't buy 'em.
mos_pirate/compliment: Honest rags. Better'n stolen silk, some days.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Rags, and still wanting our secrets. You cannot afford those either.
You came all this way with nothing. Not even patience, I see.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Poor in purse. Poorer in insight, from what I hear in there.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: No gold, no pretence. Nearly honest. Nearly.
guard/insult: No coin on you. So what are you planning to do for some?
guard/remark: Skint, by the look. The cells are free, mind. Don't get ideas.
guard/compliment: Nothing on you worth stealing. Easiest patrol I'll have all day.
barbarian/insult: Rags! Hah! Even our young ones wear furs.
barbarian/remark: Nothing worth taking off you. Saves everyone a fight.
barbarian/compliment: No gold and still you came. That's spirit, little one.

compliment: Brave, coming out here.
insult: In the Wilderness? Dressed like that?
remark: Keep your head down out here, traveller.
Wouldn't hang about, if I were you.
tzhaar/remark: Cold place, this. JalYt choose to come here? Silly JalYt.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt out here dressed like that? Lava is kinder than this place.
tzhaar/compliment: Brave JalYt, walking here. Or lost JalYt. Brave sounds better.
ogre/remark: Grrr. Bad place, dis. Even ogres don't like it. Watch yous back.
ogre/insult: Creature out here? Sumfin bigger dan ogre will eat yous. Shame.
ogre/compliment: Brave creature, coming out here. Stoopid, but brave. Ogre likes.
goblin/remark: Wilderness, human? Many ways to die up here. Bentnoze say so.
goblin/insult: Human come to Wilderness dressed like that? Human want to be dead?
goblin/compliment: Human not scared of Wilderness. Not run from battle. Commandment!
guard/remark: Nobody patrols out here. Whatever happens to you is your own affair.
This isn't my patch. Nothing is, out here.
guard/insult: No law out here. Can't arrest anyone. Terrible for morale.

compliment: Survived the barbarians' assault, have you? Fair play.
insult: Is that a jumper, or a chest wig?
remark: The barbarians gave you that? Lovely of them.

compliment: A dragon scimitar! Proper old school.
insult: A dragon scimitar. My granddad had one of those.
remark: The monkeys sold you that, did they? Rather you than me.

compliment: Very colourful. Suits you.
insult: Bit garish, that.
Looks like a vicar's Christmas jumper.
remark: Picked a side, then, have you?
vicar/remark: Ah, a fellow believer. Possibly.
goblin/remark: Painted leather. Human pick god colour. Goblins only got one god.
goblin/insult: Colourful leather. Which god? Not Big High War God. Then wrong god.
goblin/compliment: Colourful armour! Human like armour colour too! Me like human.

compliment: A chef! Lovely. What's for tea?
insult: Not cooking with those hands, I hope.
remark: Cook a decent stew, can you?
barkeep/compliment: A chef! We're always short in the kitchen.
barkeep/insult: A chef's hat? Right. Out the back, the sink's that way.

compliment: Ooh, the whole outfit. Very professional.
insult: Fancy dress, is it? Or is that the uniform?
remark: Dressed for work, I see. Good on you.
rough/compliment: Proper work clothes. Nobody dresses properly any more.
leprechaun/remark: Dressed for the patches, I see. Mind, the weeds don't care.
leprechaun/compliment: Now that's a proper farmin' rig. Ye'll be wantin' me shed, then.
leprechaun/insult: All the gear, and not a clue which end o' the dibber goes down.

compliment: Been busy, have we? Good for you.
insult: You're puffing like a bellows.
Out of breath, and it's flat all the way from the gate.
remark: Have a sit down. You're red as a beetroot.
kid/insult: Why are you so slow?
gnome/remark: Puffed out, human? We don't run here. We glide.
rough/insult: Puffed out already? Try a day on the plough.
barkeep/remark: Sit down before you fall down. Water? No, didn't think so.
fremennik/insult: Winded already? A Fremennik child would still be running.
Winded? Swensen's maze would finish you before the second room.
You breathe like Manni after a keg. He has an excuse.
heartland/remark: You look absolutely knackered.
