wizard/insult: One element on a stick. How terribly apprentice of you.
kid/remark: Can you do magic with that? Do some! Do a fire!
guard/remark: Staff with a stone on it. Keep the stone pointed at the sky.
guard/insult: No spells inside the walls. The sign's by the gate. The scorched one.
guard/compliment: A staff. At least you can't swing it very fast.

compliment: A bow. Sensible. Keeps the trouble at a distance.
insult: That bow's barely been told it isn't a branch any more.
rough/remark: Made that bow yourself, did you? It's got a lean to it.
kid/compliment: Can I have a go on your bow? I'll aim at the chickens.
guard/remark: Bow stays unstrung in town. The rabbits are outside the wall.
guard/insult: A bow. In a street. Who exactly are you planning to shoot?
guard/compliment: Little bow. Harmless enough. Keep it that way.

compliment: Plain robes. You've a peaceful look about you.
remark: Monk's robes. Off to Edgeville to pray, are you?
plain/insult: Monk's robes and no monastery. Did you just take them?
kid/insult: Why are you in a dress? Are you a monk? Monks are boring.

compliment: Mithril. Lovely blue sheen to that. Coming along nicely.
dwarf/compliment: Mithril. Now that's a metal worth the mining, human.
kid/compliment: Your armour's blue! Is it magic? It looks magic.
gnome/compliment: Mithril! Lighter than it looks, human. You almost move like a gnome.
gnome/insult: Blue armour. Very fetching, human. Matches nothing, mind.
dwarf/insult: Mithril, human. Good, but a dwarf doesn't stop there.
dwarf/remark: Mithril. Deep ore, that. Someone sweated for it.
goblin/insult: Blue armour. Blue make Grubfoot sad. Make me sad too, looking.
goblin/remark: Blue armour. Generals try blue once. Not goblin colour at all.
goblin/compliment: Blue armour. Ekeleshuun tribe wear blue. Human nearly goblin tribe.
troll/compliment: Blue metal! Pretty, like ice rocks up in cold mountains.
troll/insult: Blue armour. Blue like cold human. Cold human taste same.
troll/remark: Blue metal. Troll not know dat one. Troll bite it, find out.
guard/remark: Mithril. Light, they say. Light enough to outrun me? Don't test it.
guard/compliment: Mithril. Tidy. Nobody causes trouble in mithril. There's a first time.
guard/insult: Mithril armour, is it? Blue. Suspicious colour, blue.

compliment: Adamant! That's proper armour. You're coming along, aren't you?
kid/insult: You look like a big green beetle!
gnome/compliment: Green armour, human! Very leafy. The Grand Tree would approve.
gnome/insult: Adamant. Great Guthix, human, how do you lift your arms?
dwarf/compliment: Adamant. Hard to smith, hard to dent. Someone knew their trade.
dwarf/insult: Adamant armour. Nearly rune. Nearly is a long way, human.
dwarf/remark: Adamant. Green as a gemstone. The Green Gemstone would approve.
goblin/compliment: Green armour! Wartface say green best! Me agree. When he listening.
goblin/insult: Green armour, human? Green too much like skin. Human nearly naked.
goblin/remark: Green armour. Red goblins hit you for that. Brown goblins just stare.
troll/compliment: Green armour. Green like goutweed! Me approve.
troll/insult: Green human. Like goat food. Goat eat you, then troll eat goat.
troll/remark: Green metal. Not a plant. Me check. Not a plant.
guard/compliment: Adamant. Proper kit. The watch gets leather and a whistle.
guard/remark: Green metal on the gate. I'm noting it. Green.
guard/insult: Adamant head to toe. Expecting a war in the market, are we?

compliment: Is that dragonhide? You've been and fought a dragon, then!
insult: Green dragonhide. Still smells faintly of dragon, that.
kid/remark: Did you skin a dragon? Was it a big one? Was it scary?
goblin/compliment: Green leather! Wartface say green best! Garagorshuun tribe colour!
goblin/insult: Green leather. Green too much like skin, Bentnoze say. Nearly naked.
goblin/remark: Green dragon skin. Human kill dragon? Goblins just shout at dragon.
guard/remark: Green hide. Archer, then. Bow stays on your back in town.
guard/insult: Green dragonhide. Suspiciously quiet boots to go with it, I'll bet.
guard/compliment: Green hide, sensible boots. You'll do.

remark: Snakeskin? I do hope the snake had finished with it.
kid/compliment: You're wearing a snake! That's the best thing ever!

remark: Is that bark? You're wearing a tree, more or less.
kid/insult: You're dressed as a tree! Can I climb you?

remark: That armour looks like it came out of the sea. Does it smell?
fremennik/compliment: Dagannoth hide! You've been down in the deep caves, then.
kid/remark: You look like a crab! A big crab with legs.

item.pattern: ^(Helm of neitiznot|Berserker helm|Archer helm|Farseer helm|Warrior helm)
item.label: helm

compliment: A northern helm! You've been to Rellekka and back, I see.
Northern helm, that. You look like you crossed a sea for it.
fremennik/remark: Skulgrimen's work, that helm. Wear it with honour.
An island helm on a southerner. The trolls must be slipping.
kid/compliment: Your helmet's got pointy bits! Can I wear it?
Your helmet looks like a fish! Is it a fish?
fremennik/compliment: Hah! A proper helm. Skulgrimen does not hand those to just anyone.
fremennik/insult: A Fremennik helm. The helm is Fremennik. The head, I am less sure.
moon_clan/compliment: A northern helm. Your thoughts are gentler than it looks. Good.
moon_clan/insult: A Fremennik helm. Oh my. We fell out with those long ago, dear.
tortugan/compliment: A fine helm. A shell for the head. Very sensible.
tortugan/remark: A northern helm. The far cold sea. We do not swim there often.
troll/compliment: Horn helmet! Human look like goat. Trolls like goat.
troll/insult: Horns on head. Human look like goat. Goat taste boring.
troll/remark: Helmet with horns. Trolls bash dat off first. Then dinner.
moon_clan_wary/insult: A Fremennik helm. Pah. Horns do nothing for the mind beneath.
A Fremennik helm. Is it to keep thoughts in? It is not working.
Horns on your head. The Fremennik way: look fierce, think little.
moon_clan_wary/remark: A northern helm. They sent one of their own again. We are watching.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: A Fremennik helm, on someone who listens. A first.
barbarian/compliment: A horned helm! Now that's a proper helmet. Peksa would approve.
barbarian/remark: Horns on your helmet. Our cousins up north wear those.
barbarian/insult: Horned helm, no scars. The helmet's done more fighting than you.

vicar/compliment: Armour with Saradomin's blessing on it. It suits you.
sharp/insult: A knight's armour without the knight. Does Falador know?
kid/compliment: Are you a real knight? Have you got a horse?

guard/remark: That's a proper blade. Keep it sheathed and we'll get on.
kid/insult: I bet I could take that sword off you. I'm very quick.

compliment: A rune scimitar! Now you look like you mean business.
guard/remark: Rune blade on your hip. Move along, and keep it there.
kid/compliment: Is that a rune sword? Cor! Can I hold it? Just a bit?

compliment: A battlestaff! The magic's coming along nicely, I see.
wizard/remark: A battlestaff. Zaff's, I'd wager. He does sell a lot of them.
kid/remark: Does your stick do sparks? Make it do sparks!
guard/remark: Battlestaff, is it? It's the battle part I'm not keen on.
Staff like that, I'll want both hands on it and both in view.
guard/insult: Keep that staff still. Last one that waved, we lost a roof.

compliment: A proper bow, that. You've come a long way from sticks.
rough/remark: Good straight wood in that bow. Someone knew their trees.
kid/compliment: That's a big bow! Can you hit a bird? Not a nice bird.
guard/remark: Proper longbow. Unstrung inside the walls, if you please.
guard/insult: A bow that size, you could hit the next town. Don't.
guard/compliment: Fine bow. I'll want it on your back, not in your hand.

remark: A cape with a number on it. Off to the Wilderness, are we?
kid/remark: Your cape's got a number! Are you in a gang? Can I join?

compliment: A stone cape? Down the volcano for that, were you?
A cape of stone. You must have shoulders like an ox.
dwarf/compliment: Volcanic glass for a cape. Odd, but you can't fault the work.
kid/remark: Your cape's made of rock! Doesn't your back hurt?
remark: Is that cape made of rock? How does it swish?
kid/insult: Your cape's made of rock. You'll sink in the river.

compliment: A Legends' Guild cape, isn't it? Very distinguished.
toff/insult: The Legends' Guild, citizen? They let anyone in nowadays.
kid/compliment: Are you a legend? A real one? Prove it!

compliment: Proper dragonhide. Somebody had a very bad day for that.
insult: Dragon leather, is it? It still looks a bit cross.
kid/remark: Is that made of real dragon? Did it mind?
gnome/compliment: Dragon leather! Light enough to glide in, human. Nearly.
gnome/remark: Dragonhide. The gliders stay well clear of dragons, human. Wise.
dwarf/compliment: Dragon leather. Tough stuff, well stitched. Not metal, but not bad.
dwarf/insult: Leather, human? Next to a good steel plate, that's a nice coat.
dwarf/remark: Dragonhide. The dragon wasn't using it, I suppose.
goblin/remark: Dragon skin. Blue, red, black. Human pick tribe colour by mistake.
goblin/insult: Dragon leather. Still just leather. Goblin mail proper metal. Brown.
goblin/compliment: Dragon skin! Human fight dragon! Big High War God like that fight.
troll/remark: Dragon skin on human. Troll not eat dragon. Too big. Dragon eat troll.
troll/insult: Dragon leather. Chewy. Troll spit dat bit out.
troll/compliment: Human wear dragon skin! Human eat dragon? Big human. Big dinner.
guard/remark: Dragonhide. Archer's kit. I'll want the quiver covered in town.
guard/insult: Dragon leather. Dragons don't come through this gate. Nor do arrows.
guard/compliment: Hide armour. Quiet, light, no clanking. The sergeant would weep.

compliment: Lovely robes. You look like you know a spell or two.
wizard/insult: Robes and a pointy hat. Everyone's a wizard these days.
kid/remark: Can you turn me into a frog? Go on, just for a bit.
guard/remark: Mystic robes. No fireballs in town. We've had letters.
guard/insult: Wizard, are you? Keep your hands where I can see them. Both.
guard/compliment: Fancy robes. At least you'll not be hiding a sword in those.
barbarian/insult: Fancy robes. All that magic and not one scar. Bah!
barbarian/remark: Magic robes. We don't trust it. The sword doesn't lie.
barbarian/compliment: Fine robes. Still, you walked in here. There's nerve in that.

remark: Keep that crossbow pointed at the ground, if you would.
guard/remark: Crossbow stays unloaded inside the walls. I'm watching.
kid/compliment: Can I have a go? I'll only aim at the pigeons.

compliment: Bow cut from a magic tree. You can see it shimmer, look.
insult: A bow that pretty. I do hope you hit things with it.
kid/insult: Your bow's all sparkly. Is it for fairies?
guard/remark: Glowing bow. Shouldn't glow. I'm noting the glow.
guard/insult: Enchanted bow, in a crowd. I'd call that a public hazard.
guard/compliment: Pretty bow. I'll not pretend I'm not watching it.

remark: Small, red and wicked, that dagger. Very sensible size.
guard/remark: Dragon dagger in town, is it? I'll be keeping an eye.
kid/compliment: Your knife's red! Is it made of dragon?

compliment: Dragon metal! You've done well for yourself.
remark: Red as a forge, that. Do they make it that colour on purpose?
guard/remark: That's dragon metal. Keep it lowered and we'll get on fine.
kid/compliment: Is that from a dragon? Did you fight it yourself?
barbarian/compliment: Red metal blade! Hah! Our forefathers would've fought you for it.
barbarian/insult: Dragon weapon, and not a notch in it. Bought, then.
barbarian/remark: A red blade. The mighty sword, the vicious axe. Good choice.

compliment: Little spiked shield. Someone's been busy at the Warriors' Guild.
insult: A shield that small. Expecting very small arrows?
kid/remark: Why's your shield so tiny? Did it shrink in the wash?

compliment: Those robes have stars in them. Look, they're moving!
insult: Robes full of stars. A touch showy, if I may say.
kid/remark: Your clothes have got the night sky on them!

remark: Old staff, that. Smells faintly of desert.
wizard/insult: Ancient magicks. Popular with people who ought to know better.
kid/compliment: Your stick's all twisty and black! Is it cursed?

compliment: A proper wand. Very distinguished. You must have studied.
wizard/insult: A little wand. In my day we used staves, like grown-ups.
kid/remark: Is that a magic wand? Make a cake appear!

remark: Odd sort of book to carry about openly. Very dark cover.
vicar/insult: That's not a book I'd carry past a temple, friend.
kid/remark: Your book looks evil! Read us a bit!

remark: That shield's got a dragon on it. Is that to warn it off?
plain/insult: Dragon shield and not a dragon in sight. Ever hopeful.
kid/compliment: Does that shield stop fire? Can I set it on fire?

remark: Is that whip moving on its own? It's moving on its own.
insult: Something's wrapped round your whip. And it's wriggling.
kid/remark: Your whip's got a squid on it!

remark: That club looks like it was grown, not made.
plain/insult: Lovely club. Did it come out of something's insides?
kid/insult: Your club looks like a big gut! That's horrible!

vicar/insult: Zamorak's colours, carried past the chapel. Have you no shame?
shady/compliment: Red and black, and sharp at the end. Now you're talking.
kid/compliment: That spear's all spiky! Can I hold it?

compliment: Armadyl's colours on a crossbow. Fine work, that.
guard/remark: Fancy crossbow. Fancy or not, it stays unloaded in town.
kid/compliment: Your crossbow's got wings on it! Does it fly?

remark: A staff with a blade on it. Can't you make your mind up?
wizard/insult: A staff you hit people with. Our forefathers would weep.
kid/remark: Is that a stick or a sword? It's a stick-sword!

compliment: A blade you can see through. Elf work, that. Beautiful.
plain/insult: Glass sword. Very pretty. Very breakable, I'd think.
kid/compliment: Your sword's made of glass! Can I look through it?

remark: That's a hammer for walls, not nails.
guard/remark: Big red hammer. Leave the gates in one piece, please.
kid/insult: That hammer's bigger than your head. Your head's quite big.

remark: Claws on a person. Do you scratch at doors as well?
guard/remark: Claws in town. Hands where I can see them. Claws too.
kid/compliment: You've got claws! Are you part dragon?

remark: A snake's head for a hat. Was the snake consulted?
insult: That hat's got scales. I keep thinking it'll hiss at me.
kid/remark: You've got a snake on your head! Does it bite?

compliment: That shield's got a face on it. A cross one. Fine work.
dwarf/compliment: Dragon bone forged to a shield. That's a smith's dream, that.
kid/compliment: Your shield's got a dragon face! Make it breathe fire!

remark: You've brought a siege engine into town. Under one arm.
guard/remark: That's a siege weapon. Not in town. Not on my watch.
kid/compliment: Your crossbow's enormous! Shoot the moon!

compliment: A face like a war mask. Very fierce, very northern.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! A faceguard from the isles. You've earned a drink.
kid/remark: I can't see your face! Are you in there?

remark: Dark robes and a deep hood. You'd frighten a cultist.
vicar/insult: Chaos robes, here? I'll say a prayer for you. A long one.
shady/compliment: Robes of the old faith. You've good taste, for once.
kid/remark: Are you a bad wizard? You look like a bad wizard.

compliment: A blade like a great curved tooth. Desert make, that. Splendid.
plain/insult: Out of a pharaoh's tomb, they say. Did you knock first?
kid/compliment: Is that a giant tooth? Did you pull it out yourself?
guard/remark: That's a tooth on a handle. Keep it pointed at the ground.

compliment: That sword looks like a hole in the day. Suits you, oddly.
remark: Your sword's crackling. I can feel it in my teeth.
kid/compliment: Your sword's all purple and fizzing! Make it fizz again!
guard/remark: Crackling sword. Sheathe it, or crackle somewhere else.

compliment: That crossbow's ancient work, by the look. Very handsome.
kid/compliment: Your crossbow's purple! Purple ones are the best ones!
guard/insult: Crossbow like that in the square? Point it at the sky. Higher.

compliment: An axe that looks like it's taken a soul or two. Well carried.
remark: Is that axe whispering, or is it me? Please say it's me.
vicar/remark: An axe that feeds on souls, they say. I'll pray for yours.
kid/insult: Your axe looks hungry. Keep it away from my dog.

compliment: A hunter's bow from some old empire, by the look. Handsome.
insult: A fine bow. One hopes you're the one doing the hunting.
kid/remark: Is that a proper hunter's bow? What do you hunt? Dragons?

item.pattern: ^(Accursed sceptre|Ursine chainmace|Webweaver bow|Thammaron's sceptre|Craw's bow|Viggora's chainmace)
item.label: weapon

compliment: That's off the Wilderness dead, I'd wager. And you came back.
plain/insult: Wilderness spoils. I'd not wave them about. Someone wants them back.
shady/compliment: A weapon taken in the Wilderness. You've more nerve than I thought.
kid/remark: Did you get that in the Wilderness? Mum says I can't go there.

compliment: That's still smouldering. Demon work, by the smell. Impressive.
kid/compliment: It's on fire! Can I toast bread on it?
tzhaar/compliment: Weapon still burning. Good. JalYt learns.
guard/remark: Burning weapon inside the walls. That's a fire risk, that.
heartland/remark: Mind the thatch with that. And the hay. And me.

compliment: A Colosseum quiver! They don't hand those out lightly.
insult: A quiver where a cape should go. Bold, I suppose.
kid/compliment: Did you win that in the big arena? Did everyone cheer?
guard/remark: Colosseum quiver. Fight for crowds, do you? Not here, please.

compliment: All sun and gold, that armour. You fair glow in it.
vicar/remark: Armour for a sun god, by the look. Not ours. Nicely made, mind.
kid/insult: You look like a big orange! An orange with a helmet!

remark: Is that staff looking at me? It's looking at me.
nan/remark: A staff that watches you back, dear. I'd keep it in a drawer.
kid/compliment: Your stick's got an eye! Does it blink? Make it blink!

compliment: Armour with the moon on it. Old work, by the look. Lovely.
remark: Moon on your armour. Do you wane a bit, of an evening?
kid/remark: Why've you got the moon on your hat? It's daytime.

plain/insult: Is that a sword or a butter knife? Hard to tell from here.
guard/remark: Blade stays sheathed in town, adventurer. I'm watching.
kid/remark: Can I hold your sword? I won't swing it. Much.

compliment: A good heavy weapon. Goblins don't argue with those.
guard/remark: Keep that low, and your temper lower.
kid/compliment: Can you bonk things with that? Bonk a goblin!

compliment: A great big sword. You must have arms like a blacksmith.
guard/remark: Mind where you swing that. There are windows here.
kid/remark: Your sword's bigger than me! Is it heavy? It looks heavy.

remark: A spear in town. Hoping to catch a fish in the fountain?
guard/remark: Point that at the sky, please, not at the citizens.
kid/remark: A spear! Are you going hunting? Get me a rabbit!

insult: A stick. You've a stick. The Wizards' Tower must be trembling.
wizard/insult: A staff with nothing on top. You've bought the handle, then.
kid/insult: That's just a stick! I've got loads of sticks at home.

guard/remark: Crossbows are watched in this town. Keep it unloaded.
shady/remark: That crossbow looks familiar. Where'd you come by it?
kid/compliment: A crossbow! Shoot an apple off my head! Please!

compliment: A working tool in hand. Honest labour. Good for you.
dwarf/compliment: Honest tool for honest work. Dwarves approve, human.
kid/remark: Are you a lumberjack or a miner? You look a bit of both.

compliment: A candy cane! You've a festive look about you.
insult: Fighting with a sweet. The goblins will laugh themselves silly.
kid/remark: Can I lick it? Just once? I won't tell anyone.

remark: Carrying a snowball about? It'll melt, you know.
guard/remark: Put the snowball down. Slowly. Nobody needs to get wet.
kid/remark: Don't throw it at me! Throw it at my sister!

compliment: A little tiara. Very regal, in a small way.
toff/insult: A tiara on the peasantry. Whatever next, a throne?
kid/remark: Are you a princess? You've got a crown!

compliment: A boater! How smart. Very summery.
toff/compliment: A boater. At last, someone with a sense of occasion.
kid/remark: Your hat's flat on top! Can I put my cup on it?

remark: A beret. Very artistic. Do you paint?
insult: A beret. Off to sell paintings nobody asked for?
kid/remark: Your hat's all floppy! Like a pancake!

rough/compliment: Mining helmet. Someone's done their time underground.
dwarf/compliment: A lamp on the helm! Proper miner's gear, human.
kid/remark: You've got a lamp on your head! Can you see in the dark?

remark: You've a fishbowl on your head. Where's the fish?
insult: A goldfish bowl. Did the fish move out, or did you evict it?
kid/remark: You look like a fish! A fish wearing a fish house!

compliment: An animal face! Very jolly. Off to a masked ball?
insult: Lovely mask. An improvement, if I'm honest.
kid/remark: Do the noise! Go on! What noise does it make?

compliment: A woolly hat. Warm ears are happy ears.
nan/compliment: Lovely woolly hat, dear. Did someone knit you that?
kid/remark: Your hat looks so warm! Can I have it after?

compliment: A priest's gown. Good to see the cloth out and about.
vicar/compliment: Greetings, traveller. The gown suits you. Saradomin smile on you.
kid/remark: Are you a priest? Do you know any ghost stories?

compliment: Druid's robes. You've a good earthy look about you.
wizard/insult: Druids. Herbs and stone circles. Charming, in a mossy way.
kid/remark: You smell like leaves! Good leaves, though.

vicar/insult: Zamorak's colours. I'll pray for you, whether you like it or not.
guard/remark: Zamorakian robes. I'll be keeping an eye on you.
kid/remark: Mum says not to talk to people in red robes. Bye!

remark: An apron. Baking, smithing, or ready for anything?
barkeep/compliment: An apron! Grab a cloth, we're short-handed tonight.
kid/remark: Are you making cakes? Can I lick the bowl?

compliment: Gold for the kitchen! Very grand for a cook.
barkeep/remark: Gold apron, is it? Don't spill gravy down that.
kid/compliment: You're all gold! Are you the king of the kitchen?

remark: Got any sandwiches? You look like you've got sandwiches.
insult: Dressed as the sandwich lady. She'll want her tray back.
barkeep/remark: Selling sandwiches? Not in here you're not.
kid/compliment: The sandwich lady! Can I have a free one? Please?

compliment: Robes from Kourend, by the look. Very scholarly.
wizard/insult: That robe hums with old magic. More than its wearer does.
kid/remark: Your robes look old! Did you find them in a tomb?

insult: Khazard's armour. Did you rob a guard, or just sit on one?
guard/remark: Khazard's livery. You're a long way from his arena.
kid/remark: You look like the nasty guards from the arena! Are you nasty?

remark: A hard hat. Expecting something to fall on you?
toff/insult: A tradesman. The servants' entrance is round the side.
kid/remark: Are you building a tower? Can I have the top room?

compliment: A nice plain skirt. Comfy for walking, I should think.
insult: A skirt, and nothing much to go with it. Brave choice.
kid/remark: Your skirt's all swishy! Do a twirl!

compliment: Gnome fashion! You've been up the Grand Tree, haven't you?
gnome/compliment: Rometti's work, human! You wear it almost properly.
kid/remark: You're dressed like a gnome! You're too big to be a gnome!

compliment: A nice bright cape. Every adventurer needs one.
insult: A plain dyed cape. Everybody's got one of those.
kid/compliment: Swish your cape! Go on, swish it! Like a hero!

remark: Spotted fur. Where did you find a cat that big?
rough/compliment: Kebbit fur, that. Someone's been out with a falcon.
kid/remark: Your cape's got spots! Does it bite?
Your cape's got spots! Is it catching?
compliment: Lovely spotted fur. You've been hunting, I see.
rough/remark: Kebbit fur, that. Fast little things to catch.
insult: Spotty cape. Matches nothing, if I may say.

remark: Is your cape made of cabbage? It is. It's cabbage.
insult: A cabbage cape. Did the field lose a fight with you?
kid/insult: You're wearing cabbages! Mum makes me eat those!

remark: Bells on your cape. We'll hear you coming, at least.
toff/compliment: A jester! How amusing. Do juggle something.
kid/remark: Your cape jingles! Jingle it again!

remark: There's a parrot on your shoulder. Did you know?
pirate/compliment: Arr, a parrot! Now ye look like a proper sea dog.
plain/insult: That bird's left something on your shoulder, by the way.
kid/compliment: A parrot! Does it talk? Make it say something rude!

remark: Is that a wolf on your head? It's a wolf on your head.
Wearing a wolf, are we? Warm, I'd imagine.
fremennik/compliment: Dressed as a wolf, outerlander. Good. Wolves are respected.
A wolf's hide. You have hunted, outerlander.
kid/remark: Are you a werewolf? Do a howl! Awoo!
plain/insult: Wolf skin. The wolf looked better in it.
kid/compliment: You're a wolf! Howl! Go on, howl!

compliment: A defender. You've been at the Warriors' Guild, then.
guard/remark: A blade in each hand. That's one more than I like to see.
kid/remark: You've got a sword in your other hand too! Two swords!

remark: A shield you made yourself, by the look. Good on you.
insult: Mind the dragons. That shield's kindling to them.
kid/remark: Is that a tray? It looks like a tray!

compliment: A great blue sword. You've been saving up for that one.
guard/remark: That sword's longer than my arm. Walk it carefully, please.
kid/compliment: That sword's bigger than me! Can I hold it? Just the end?

dwarf/compliment: Rune, and a good honest head on it. You'll go far.
guard/remark: Heavy blue metal on a stick. Mind how you swing it in here.
kid/remark: Have you squashed anything with that? Squash something!

compliment: A rune blade. Someone's been working hard, I see.
guard/remark: That's a fine blade. Kindly keep it pointing at the ground.
kid/compliment: Your sword's blue! Is it made out of sky?

remark: Adamant, by the green of it. Coming along nicely, aren't you?
dwarf/remark: Adamant. Decent stuff. Rune's better, but you'll get there.
kid/insult: Your weapon's green. Has it gone mouldy?

remark: A dark staff with a nasty point. Off hunting monsters, are we?
wizard/remark: A slayer's staff. Good for one spell, that. Very specialised.
kid/compliment: Do you kill monsters with that? Real ones? Big ones?
slayer_master/remark: A slayer's staff. Sensible, for some of the things out there.

remark: That bow's nearly as tall as you. Borrowed it off an ogre?
ogre/compliment: Ha! Good big bow. Make chompy go splat.
kid/compliment: That's the biggest bow I ever saw! Shoot the moon!

compliment: A proper wand! Been studying at the arena, have you?
wizard/insult: A student's wand. We all start somewhere. Some of us stay there.
kid/remark: Wave it! Turn the cat into a bigger cat!

compliment: Been fighting at the barbarian outpost? You look the part.
fremennik/compliment: You stood with the barbarians against the Penance. Good.
kid/compliment: Is that a barbarian hat? Are you a barbarian? Roar for me!

remark: That skirt's an odd colour. That's not cloth, is it?
rough/insult: Nice skirt. Very swishy. Very brave.
kid/remark: You've got a skirt on! Are you going to a party?

remark: A mask? What do you know about the air round here that I don't?
insult: Is it my breath? You can just say if it's my breath.
kid/remark: You look like a big fly! Do the buzzing!

remark: Dressed as a mourner. Off to West Ardougne, are we?
plain/insult: Mourner's clothes. Cheerful lot, mourners. Like you, I expect.
kid/insult: You look like a crow. A sad crow.

remark: Funny shield, that. Looks like it came out of a workshop.
dwarf/compliment: Elemental metal. Took some smithing, that. Good on you.
kid/remark: Your shield's got a picture on it! What is it?

remark: Wearing a whole big cat, are you? Bold.
nan/compliment: Lovely warm furs, dear. You'll not catch a chill in those.
kid/compliment: You're a tiger! Roar! Do the roar!

remark: Dressed to blend in somewhere. It isn't here, I'm afraid.
insult: Camouflage in the middle of town. Very nearly worked.
kid/remark: I can still see you! You're not very good at hiding.

remark: Funny robes. Like something off an island nobody visits.
moon_clan/remark: Our robes, on an outsider. Mind you keep them clean.
kid/remark: You look like a witch! A nice one, though.

wizard/compliment: Enchanted robes. You've been at the training arena, I see.
toff/remark: Splendid robes. Rather loud, but splendid.
kid/remark: You're all sparkly! Are you a real wizard?

remark: Is that frog? You're wearing frog. Of all the things.
plain/insult: Frog leather. Smells a bit of pond, if I'm honest.
kid/compliment: You're wearing frogs! Can you jump really high now?

remark: Sailor's togs! Very shipshape. Which boat are you off?
pirate/compliment: Arr, smart coat, matey. Ye'd make a fine first mate.
kid/compliment: Are you a sailor? Have you got a ship? Can I see it?

remark: Black robes, very gloomy. Been somewhere with a lot of ghosts?
vicar/compliment: Plain dark robes. Humble. I approve.
kid/insult: You look like a shadow! Go away, shadow!

compliment: Very smart armour. Very shiny. Not a dent on it, mind.
toff/compliment: Now that is armour fit for a portrait. Splendid.
kid/compliment: You look like a knight out of a story!

remark: Wearing your colours, I see. Saradomin or Zamorak, is it?
vicar/remark: Team colours. I trust you picked the right god.
kid/remark: Are you on the red team or the blue team? I'm on blue.

vicar/insult: Skulls on your cape. I shall pray for you.
guard/remark: Skulls on the cape, eh? I'll be keeping my eye on you.
kid/compliment: Skulls! Are they real? Can I have one?

compliment: Varrock's own colours on your chest. The city thanks you.
guard/compliment: Varrock armour. You've done the city a good turn, then.
kid/compliment: Your armour's got Varrock on it! I live in Varrock!

remark: Is that a lamp on your head? Expecting a dark evening?
gnome/compliment: Kandarin headgear! You've been busy in our part of the world.
kid/remark: Your hat's got a light on it! Can you see in the dark?

remark: Those legs have a touch of the swamp about them.
vicar/compliment: You've done good work in Morytania. Bless you for it.
kid/insult: Your trousers look like they've been in a bog.

remark: A knobbly old stick. Walking far, are we?
wizard/remark: Dramen wood. You've been somewhere you shouldn't, I suspect.
kid/insult: That's just a stick. I've got loads of sticks.

compliment: That sword looks like it belongs in a lake. Or a legend.
toff/compliment: A blade fit for a king of the Round Table, I'd say.
kid/compliment: Did you pull that out of a stone? Did you? Did you?

remark: You've got rats on a stick. Why have you got rats on a stick?
barkeep/insult: Not in here with those rats, thank you. Leave them outside.
kid/compliment: Rats on a stick! Can I have one? Just a little one?

compliment: Gold and jewels on a stick. You've robbed a tomb, haven't you?
shady/compliment: Pharaoh's gold. I'd ask where from, but I know where from.
vicar/insult: Gold from a tomb. The dead do not forget, you know.
kid/compliment: Your stick's made of gold! Are you a king?

remark: There's a bear on your head. Did the bear agree to that?
fremennik/compliment: A bear's head for a helm. Well earned, I hope.
kid/remark: A bear's eating your head! Does it hurt?

remark: A jester! Go on then, make me laugh. I'll wait.
insult: Bells on your hat. We'll hear you coming, at least.
toff/remark: A fool in motley. Every court should have one.
kid/compliment: Jingle jingle! Do a cartwheel! Do a funny walk!

remark: Shayzien colours. Off to fight lizardmen, are we?
guard/compliment: Shayzien kit. Proper soldier's armour, that.
kid/remark: Have you fought a lizard man? Was he slimy?

remark: A square shield. Not a corner wasted.
dwarf/compliment: Rune square shield. Plain and sturdy, the way it should be.
kid/remark: Your shield's a square! Mine's a pan lid.

compliment: Gleaming white armour. A White Knight, are you?
shady/insult: White Knight. All shine on the outside, your sort.
vicar/compliment: The White Knights' colours. Saradomin smile on you.
kid/compliment: You're so shiny! Are you a real knight?

compliment: A champion's cape! Beaten the lot of them, have you?
rough/compliment: Champion's colours. Not many wear those. Fair play.
kid/compliment: Are you the champion? Of everything? Of the world?

remark: A black mask. Should I be holding on to my purse?
guard/remark: Masked, are we? I've got my eye on you, mask or no.
Masked, are we? I'll be keeping an eye on you.
plain/insult: Black mask. Hiding from someone, or from a mirror?
kid/compliment: You look like a villain! A good one, I mean!
shady/compliment: Nice mask. Very discreet. We should talk sometime.
kid/remark: Are you a robber? You look like a robber!
slayer_master/remark: A black mask. Somebody's been down in the caves.
heartland/remark: A black mask in broad daylight. Very mysterious, that.

remark: Dressed for something nasty, by the look of your head.
insult: Forgive me, but you look like you've lost a wager.
rough/remark: Whatever you're off to fight, I don't want to smell it.
kid/insult: You look silly! What's that on your face for?
slayer_master/compliment: Good. You listened about the protective gear.

compliment: A tall hat like that, you must be someone in the temple.
vicar/insult: A bishop's hat on an adventurer. Does the temple know?
sharp/insult: Mind the doorframes in that hat, your holiness.
kid/remark: Your hat's ever so tall! Is your head that shape?

remark: Is that a halo? I'll be the judge of that, thank you.
vicar/insult: A halo is earned, friend, not worn on a whim.
plain/insult: A halo, on you? Somebody's having us on.
kid/compliment: You've got a halo! Are you an angel? Can you fly?
compliment: A halo! You must be better behaved than you look.
insult: A halo? On you? Somebody's been generous.
vicar/remark: A halo, is it? I'll be the judge of that.
nan/compliment: A halo! What a good child you must have been, dear.
kid/remark: There's a ring floating on your head! How?

compliment: What a hat! All you need now is a duel to fight.
toff/compliment: A proper cavalier. One almost takes you for a gentleman.
insult: That's a lot of feather for one head, if you don't mind.
kid/remark: There's a whole bird on your hat! Where's the rest?

remark: A green cap with a feather. Off to rob the rich, are we?
toff/insult: That hat. Keep well away from my purse, citizen.
insult: Fine feather. Shame about the rest of the outfit.
kid/compliment: You look like an outlaw! Can you shoot an apple?

remark: Gave me a turn, that dragon head. Do take it off indoors.
insult: A dragon's face. An improvement, if I may say so.
rough/remark: Blimey! Thought a dragon had got into the village.
kid/compliment: You're a dragon! Breathe fire! Go on, breathe fire!

remark: A tall green hat with a buckle. Feeling lucky, are we?
trader/remark: Lucky hat, is it? Then you can afford my prices, friend.
plain/insult: Lucky hat? Your luck's not reached the rest of you.
kid/remark: Have you got a pot of gold? Can I have some?
leprechaun/remark: Where'd ye get that hat? That's one of ours, so it is.

compliment: Fine vestments. Off to lead a service, are we?
vicar/compliment: Robes of the faith. Blessings on you, traveller.
shady/insult: Dressed for the temple. How dreadfully devout.
kid/remark: Are you a priest? You don't look old enough.

compliment: Very smart. Off somewhere nice, are we?
toff/compliment: Decent tailoring at last. I'd almost have you to dinner.
plain/insult: All dressed up, and nowhere better to be than here.
kid/insult: You look like you're going to a wedding! Is it yours?

remark: Monk's robes with gold on? That's not very humble.
vicar/insult: Gilding a habit, friend. Vanity in sackcloth.
compliment: Those robes have been trimmed lovely. Very tidy.
kid/remark: Monks are poor. Why are your robes all gold?

remark: Bark armour. Mind no woodpeckers take a fancy to you.
wizard/compliment: Grown, not forged. There's magic in that bark.
insult: Do pardon me, but you look rather like a hedge.
kid/insult: You're made of wood! Can I knock on you?

remark: Very solemn robes. Been somewhere gloomy, have you?
vicar/remark: Temple robes from the dark lands. You've been busy.
plain/insult: You look like you've come from a funeral. Yours?
kid/remark: You look ever so serious. Are you sad?

remark: Those robes look like they hold secret meetings.
Dark robes. Very dark. Joined a cult, have you?
shady/compliment: Now that's the cut of a true believer. Welcome.
Dagon'hai robes. Wear them with pride, friend.
vicar/insult: Robes like those, friend? I shall pray for you.
Those robes have a whiff of Zamorak about them.
kid/remark: Are you a dark wizard? Is it fun?
You look like a scary monk!
wizard/remark: The Dagon'hai were turned out for a reason, you know.

remark: Is that armour or a wall? Hard to tell from here.
Is that armour made of stone? Actual stone?
dwarf/compliment: Good honest stone. A dwarf could live in that.
Granite! Now there's a sensible material.
plain/insult: Wearing a quarry now, are we? Mind the floorboards.
kid/remark: You're made of rock! Are you a statue?
insult: Stone armour. You'll sink like one, mind.
kid/insult: You're wearing rocks. Why are you wearing rocks?

remark: A cloak in a god's colours. Picked a side, then.
Wearing your god on your back. Very loyal.
vicar/compliment: Wear your faith on your back. Good for you, friend.
shady/insult: Wrong god on that cloak. Do watch yourself.
kid/compliment: Your cloak's got a picture on it! It's so swishy!
insult: A cloak in your god's colours. Bit of a show-off.
vicar/remark: Which god is that cloak for? I can never keep track.
kid/remark: Is that a flag? Why are you wearing a flag?

compliment: A proper explorer's pack. Where are you off to?
insult: Packed for a long journey, and you're still in town.
trader/remark: Room in that pack for a few bargains, my friend?
kid/remark: What's in your bag? Have you got snacks?

remark: That shield looks like a lump of the volcano.
A shield made of black glass. Do try not to drop it.
tzhaar/compliment: Good shield, JalYt. You carry it with honour.
Good obsidian, JalYt. You carry it well.
dwarf/compliment: Volcanic glass, shaped proper. Heavy, I'll bet.
kid/remark: Your shield's all black and shiny! Is it a rock?
insult: Spikes on a shield. Bit much, isn't it?
kid/compliment: Spiky shield! Can I touch the spikes?

remark: Reading while you walk? Mind the cart ruts.
wizard/compliment: Ah, a scholar. Carry it open, it impresses people.
wizard/insult: Holding a book is not the same as reading it.
kid/insult: You've brought homework outside. Why would you do that?

remark: A holy book on your arm. A devout sort, are we?
Reading while you walk? You'll walk into something.
vicar/compliment: Scripture at the ready. Gods smile on you, friend.
A holy book! Bless you, traveller. Do read it.
plain/insult: Carrying a holy book doesn't make you holy, mind.
kid/remark: Are you going to read me a story? A short one?
insult: Carrying a holy book doesn't make you holy, you know.
wizard/remark: Scripture in the shield hand. A novel defence.
kid/insult: Books are boring. Why'd you bring a book?

remark: Can you see yourself in that shield? I can see myself.
nan/compliment: Oh, how handy, dear. I can check my hair in that.
plain/insult: A mirror for a shield. Vain, or just clever?
kid/compliment: I can see my face in your shield! I'm pulling a face!

compliment: Falador's colours on your shield. Done that city proud.
guard/remark: Falador shield, eh? Don't go waving it in here.
toff/insult: A Falador shield. How terribly provincial.
kid/compliment: Are you a white knight? You've got their shield!

remark: Nasty-looking shield. Where in the world was that made?
That shield looks like it was forged in a temper.
vicar/insult: Put that shield away, friend. It reeks of old evil.
I don't care for that shield. It feels unwholesome.
shady/compliment: Now that's a shield with a proper history.
An evil-looking ward. I like it.
kid/remark: Your shield looks angry! Has it got a face?
Your shield looks angry. Why's it angry?

remark: There's a face on that shield. It's looking at me.
ogre/compliment: Ogre shield! You fight like ogre now. Good.
insult: Forgive me, but your shield's prettier than you are.
kid/insult: Your shield's pulling a face at me! Make it stop!

remark: Blade shaped like a leaf. Pretty, for something sharp.
guard/remark: Funny-shaped blade. Keep it sheathed in town.
plain/insult: Leaf-shaped. Off to prune something, are we?
kid/remark: Your sword's a leaf! Can you chop a tree with it?

compliment: A god's staff. That's no ordinary walking stick.
wizard/compliment: Earned in the arena, that. I'll grant you some respect.
vicar/remark: Wield it wisely, friend. The gods do keep watch.
kid/remark: Is that a magic stick? Do a spell! A big one!

compliment: Dragon metal on a working tool. That's a proper trade.
dwarf/compliment: Fine dragon steel, that. I'd mine with it all day.
rough/remark: A red tool like that? Someone's serious about their work.
kid/remark: Your tool's red! Does it go faster?

compliment: That blade looks like it's seen off a demon or two.
vicar/compliment: A holy blade against the dark. Saradomin smile on you.
guard/remark: Odd glint on that sword. Keep it pointed at demons.
kid/compliment: Your sword's glowing! Have you killed a demon?

remark: A wavy dagger. Someone forged that in a hurry, or on purpose.
guard/remark: Twisty knife you've got. Keep it out of sight.
plain/insult: Bent dagger. Did you sit on it?
kid/remark: Your knife's all wiggly! Is it broken?

remark: That staff gives me a chill. Where did you find it?
vicar/insult: Dark wood, darker past. Burn that, friend.
wizard/remark: An old staff with a foul name behind it. Careful.
kid/insult: Your stick looks evil! Is it cursed? Are you?

remark: You're carrying an anchor. As a weapon. Well, I never.
pirate/compliment: Arr, a proper anchor! Ye'll never drift off course.
guard/remark: An anchor. In town. I don't even have a rule for that.
kid/compliment: You've got a ship's anchor! Where's the ship?

compliment: That wand looks older than the Wizards' Tower.
That wand hums. I can hear it from here.
remark: Odd little wand. It feels like it's watching me.
wizard/insult: A wand that fine, and you wave it about like a ladle.
kid/remark: Can you turn my brother into a newt? Please?
Can you turn me into a frog? Only for a bit?
wizard/compliment: A wand of the old Kourend sort. I'd trade my beard for it.

compliment: That lance has a dragon's look about it. Fitting.
Dragon-hunting gear, that. Brave work, or daft.
insult: A lance and no horse. Where did you leave it?
guard/remark: Long lance, that. Keep it pointed at the sky, please.
kid/compliment: Have you killed a dragon with that? A big one?
Have you poked a dragon with that? Did it cry?
remark: A lance with a dragon's head on it. Bit on the nose.
guard/insult: No jousting in the square. I don't care whose lance it is.

remark: That knife looks like it grew rather than got forged.
insult: Is that dagger breathing? Tell me it isn't breathing.
guard/remark: Keep that knife sheathed while you're in town.
kid/insult: Your knife looks like a slug. A sharp slug.

compliment: Now that's a sceptre. Very old, very grand.
shady/compliment: A sceptre of the old empire. You have taste.
wizard/remark: Zarosian work, if I'm any judge. Keep it out of sight.
An old Zarosian sceptre. Some magic ought to stay buried.
vicar/insult: I'd not carry that stick near a chapel, traveller.
I'd not carry that sceptre past a chapel, traveller.
kid/remark: Is that a king's stick? Are you a king?
remark: That sceptre looks older than the town. Older than the hill.
kid/compliment: Are you a king? You've got a king stick!

remark: Your tool's on fire. I thought you ought to know.
insult: Mind where you swing that. My hat's flammable.
rough/compliment: A tool that burns as it works. Saves on kindling.
tzhaar/remark: Made in the fire of the Inferno, JalYt. Do not waste it.
kid/compliment: It's on fire and you're holding it! Doesn't it hurt?

insult: That halberd looks like a spider's leg. Say it isn't.
remark: That blade's dripping. I'd rather not know with what.
That halberd's made of spider. I can see the legs.
guard/remark: Long weapon, that. Mind the lanterns.
kid/remark: Is that made of spider? It's got spider bits on!
nan/remark: Spider bits on a pole, dear. I shan't sleep tonight.
kid/compliment: Is that a spider sword? Can I hold it? I won't drop it.

remark: You throw that, do you? And it comes back? Clever.
insult: Throw that in town and I'll not be the one catching it.
guard/remark: Nothing gets thrown in this city. Nothing.
kid/compliment: Throw it! Throw it at the pigeons!

compliment: Lovely work, that thrower. Dark as a moon gone out.
insult: A stick for throwing sticks. Whatever next.
remark: A spear-thrower. You don't see those outside Varlamore.
kid/remark: What's that stick for? Do you throw the stick?

remark: Two clubs full of glass teeth. Rather you than them.
Two clubs with teeth in. Is one not enough?
insult: Two clubs? Couldn't you decide which one you liked?
guard/remark: One club is a weapon. Two is a statement. Move along.
kid/compliment: Two of them! I'd want two of them as well!
Two clubs! With teeth! Can you do a spin?
guard/insult: Two weapons, one pair of hands. Put one down, at least.

compliment: That's a wicked-looking bow. Proper wicked.
remark: That bow's darker than a bow has any right to be.
shady/compliment: A fine dark bow. Your sort usually makes do with oak.
guard/remark: Unstring that bow while you're in town, please.
kid/insult: Your bow's gone mouldy. You should give it a wash.

remark: That spear's got a wavy blade. Desert work, is it?
That spear's got a wavy blade. Did it come out wrong?
insult: A wiggly spear. Did it melt in the sun?
trader/compliment: Desert steel, my friend! Worth a pretty penny, that.
kid/remark: Your spear's all squiggly!
Your spear's all wobbly! Did you sit on it?
compliment: A wavy desert spear. For beetles, they say. Big beetles.
guard/insult: Put the wiggly spear away, please. This is a town.

compliment: That hide's got a lovely shimmer. Serpent, is it?
insult: Scaly. Very scaly. Do you shed?
remark: Hide off that great serpent in Varlamore? Brave tailor.
trader/compliment: Real serpent hide, that. Nobody can fake that colour.
kid/compliment: You look like a snake! A nice snake.

remark: Those robes have a moonish look. Lunar Isle, is it?
moon_clan/compliment: You wear our clan's robes well, traveller.
wizard/insult: Moon robes. Dream magic. Not proper magic at all.
fremennik/insult: Moon Clan robes, outerlander? They've hexed our boats.
kid/compliment: Your clothes have got moons on! Ooh!

item.pattern: (?:^(Statius's|Vesta's|Morrigan's|Zuriel's) )|(?:^(Vesta's (chainbody|plateskirt)|Statius's (full helm|platebody|platelegs)|Zuriel's (hood|robe top|robe bottom)|Morrigan's (coif|leather body|leather chaps)))|(?:^(Vesta's (longsword|spear|blighted longsword)|Statius's warhammer|Zuriel's staff|Morrigan's (javelin|throwing axe)))

compliment: That's armour from the old wars. Where did you find it?
Armour from the old wars, that. I thought it had all crumbled.
remark: Gear like that comes out of the Wilderness, or nowhere.
Didn't that armour belong to someone famous? Long dead, I hope.
An old warrior's weapon. They say those crumble in the end.
shady/compliment: Wilderness spoils. You don't flinch, do you?
dwarf/compliment: Nobody's forged like that since the God Wars. Lovely.
kid/remark: You look like a statue in the square!
That armour's from a story! A really old story!
guard/insult: That's an ancient warrior's weapon. Wilderness stock, I'll bet.
shady/remark: Took that out of the Wilderness, did you? And came back? Hm.
kid/compliment: Did you win that off a ghost? A really old ghost?

remark: That book looks like it'd bite if you opened it.
insult: A book in a fight. Will you bore them to death?
wizard/compliment: An elemental tome! The Tower has nothing so fine.
kid/remark: Is it a spell book? Read one out! Go on!

compliment: That's the Myths' Guild cape. You've done something big.
insult: A guild cape. They'll let anyone in these days.
toff/remark: The Myths' Guild. Rather exclusive, one hears.
kid/compliment: That's a fancy cape! Are you a hero?

remark: Is that a shell on your back? Are you hiding in it?
insult: You look like a tortoise in a hurry.
pirate/remark: A tortugan shell, eh? Gryphon waters, them.
kid/compliment: You're a turtle! Can you go in your shell?

compliment: Gold and blue, that shield. Desert work, and none of it cheap.
insult: A shield that shiny. You'll dazzle the thing you're fighting.
vicar/remark: A ward blessed by the desert gods. Saradomin won't mind. Probably.
kid/compliment: Your shield's all gold! Is it real gold? Can I bite it?

compliment: Robes like that, a wizard would trade his tower for.
remark: Your robes have gone all twisty. Was that on purpose?
wizard/insult: Twisted robes, twisted hat. One does wonder about the wearer.
kid/remark: Your hat's all curly at the top! Like a snail!

compliment: Blood-red armour. You look like the last thing a knight sees.
remark: Is that armour red, or has something happened?
vicar/insult: Armour the colour of blood. I'll not ask whose.
guard/remark: Red armour, head to foot. I'll be keeping an eye on you.
kid/compliment: You're all red and spiky! Are you a monster?

compliment: That armour shines like a chapel window. Very fine.
insult: You shine like a polished kettle. I can see my face in your knees.
vicar/compliment: Infernal metal, made clean again. Now that's a sermon.
kid/compliment: You're glowing! Are you an angel?

compliment: A twisted little shield. Odd shape. Very well made.
insult: That shield's ever so small. Does it cover much? Your hand?
kid/remark: Your shield looks like a big snail shell!

compliment: Master of every craft, and the arena besides. Blimey.
remark: Every craft going and the arena too. When do you sleep?
insult: A cape for everything, with a quiver on. Some can't choose.
kid/compliment: Your cape's got arrows in it! Shoot one! At the sky!

compliment: That's a veteran's cape. You've been somewhere awful, often.
remark: That's a cape you get for going back. And back. And back.
fremennik/compliment: A cape won many times over. You honour your hall, outerlander.
kid/remark: Did you win that cape? What did you do? Was it scary?

compliment: They say the elves don't give those capes out lightly. Well done.
insult: An elven cape. Did they make you sing for it?
wizard/remark: Prifddinas work, that cape. The elves are fussy who they honour.
kid/compliment: Did the elves give you that? Do they live in trees?

compliment: The hood as well? A master of everything, down to the hat.
insult: A hood to match the cape. Some people do like to be sure.
remark: You'll be the one who's good at everything. I'd know that hood.
kid/remark: Your hood matches your cape! Did your mum make you?

remark: Matching hood and all. You've thought about this.
insult: The hood as well. In case anyone missed the cape.
nan/compliment: A hood! Good. Keeps your ears warm, dear.
kid/insult: Why the hood? Is it only raining on you?

remark: You look like you've had a bad night. Since you died.
vicar/remark: Are you still with us, traveller? Just checking.
kid/compliment: I can see your bones! Do it again! Do the bones!

insult: Someone's left you in the bandage drawer too long.
nan/remark: All those bandages! Are you hurt, dear? Shall I fetch someone?
kid/remark: Mummy! No, not my mummy. You!

remark: For a moment I thought a demon had come for the rent.
compliment: Good mask, that. Gave me a proper turn.
vicar/insult: A demon's face, worn for fun. Saradomin has a long memory.
kid/compliment: Rarr! Do it again! Do the demon!

compliment: Fine foreign armour. From over the sea, is it?
remark: That hat's like an upturned bowl. Keeps the rain off, I'll grant.
kid/remark: Your hat's a pointy bowl!

remark: Dark robes, dark hood. Off to a meeting, are we?
wizard/insult: Robes of darkness. How very dramatic. Do you also cackle?
kid/insult: You look like a shadow that forgot to go home.

remark: I didn't know we'd a royal visit today. Should I bow?
insult: Very regal. A king of somewhere small, I should think.
toff/insult: A crown? Citizen, there are proper channels for that sort of thing.
kid/compliment: Are you a king? Can I have a gold coin? Kings have loads.

compliment: Now that's a hat. You don't see one like it twice.
remark: That's a hat with opinions, that is.
toff/compliment: Finally, someone round here dressed with a little style.
kid/remark: Ha! What's that on your head?

remark: Swaying a bit there, friend. Steady on.
barkeep/insult: Bring your own ale past my door, would you? Cheek.
kid/remark: Why are you walking all wobbly? Are you poorly?

compliment: A feathered hat and a tabard. Very dashing, very foreign.
toff/compliment: Now there's a hat worth doffing. Splendid feather.
kid/remark: Your hat's got a feather! Did you catch the bird?

remark: Father Christmas gone off, is it? Very festive. Very wrong.
nan/insult: That's not a nice face for Christmas, dear. Not nice at all.
kid/insult: You're the bad one! You take the presents! Shoo!

remark: Robes like that are for a ceremony. I'd rather not know which.
wizard/compliment: Old Zarosian vestments. Someone's been down the prison, hm?
kid/remark: Your mask's got a funny face. Is that you underneath?

monkey/compliment: A ninja! Quick on the rooftops, I bet. Awowogei's guards like you.
monkey/remark: Ninja monkeys keep to the shadows. You keep to the middle of the path.
Off to run the agility course? Mind the swing ropes.
monkey/insult: Funny-looking ninja. Bit stiff in the tail, you are.

monkey/compliment: Don't eat my bananas, zombie. Please. I'll share.
monkey/remark: A zombie monkey, up and about. The temple's lost one, then.
monkey/insult: Phew. You smell like the bottom of the temple.

monkey/compliment: A gorilla! Big and strong. You guard the temple, do you?
That beard, if you've got one, is very distinguished.
monkey/remark: Gorillas keep to the temple. What brings you out here?
monkey/insult: Gorillas aren't usually so clumsy. You walk like a human.

monkey/compliment: Old as the island, you look. Marimbo bless you.
monkey/remark: An ancient one! I thought your kind were only bones now.
monkey/insult: Ancient, are you? You don't look a day over a hundred.

monkey/compliment: Welcome to Marim, cousin. Mind the guards, they're fussy.
monkey/remark: Karamja monkeys. Always smell of seawater and bananas.
monkey/insult: A Karamja monkey. Country cousin, are you? Mind the big town.

monkey/compliment: Kruk's shape suits you better than it ever suited him.
monkey/remark: You look just like Kruk. Please don't look like Kruk.
monkey/insult: Kruk's face, on a stranger. Awowogei won't like that one bit.

monkey/compliment: A human who bothered to learn our words. Well, to wear them.
monkey/remark: A talking human. That amulet's doing all the work, isn't it?
monkey/insult: You speak monkey like a gnome speaks monkey. Badly.

compliment: A little lava beast, tamed. You must be braver than you look.
Not many could keep a thing like that at heel. Fair play.
insult: It's glowing. I do hope that's not your idea of a lantern.
Your creature's smouldering. I'd worry about the company it keeps.
remark: It's giving off heat from here. Handy in winter, I suppose.
kid/remark: Is it on fire? Can I poke it?
kid/insult: Yours is a rock on fire. Mine's a dog. Mine's better.
nan/remark: Keep that off my doorstep, dear. I've just swept.
vicar/remark: That looks straight out of Zamorak's own hearth. Not in here.
rough/remark: Blimey. Don't let that anywhere near the hay.
heartland/remark: Is that thing smouldering? Keep it off the thatch.

compliment: That little thing glows like a forge, and it minds you. Well done.
That came from somewhere very deep, and chose to come back with you.
insult: All teeth and temper, that. It's clearly learnt from somebody.
Your creature looks like it eats adventurers. Does it know you're one?
remark: Does it bite? It looks like it bites.
That thing's giving off heat. Stand a bit further off, would you?
kid/remark: Is that a lava monster? Is it yours? Can it melt things?
toff/remark: Is that thing volcanic? Keep it off the rugs, citizen.
wizard/remark: Obsidian and heat, bound into a thing that follows. I want one.

compliment: A cave lizard, and it comes when called? You've a way with beasts.
Ugly little thing, but it clearly adores you. That's rare.
insult: Your lizard's got more teeth than you've got sense, I'd wager.
Did you find that in a cave, or did it find you?
remark: What is that? Some cave lizard? It's staring at me.
Pale as a mushroom, that creature. Never seen daylight, I'd say.
kid/remark: It's got big eyes. Why's it got big eyes?
kid/insult: Your lizard looks like it's never been outside. Same as you.
wizard/remark: Something from very deep underground, that. Keep it off my books.
rough/remark: Keep that off the fish stall. It's got that look.

compliment: I've no idea what that is, but it follows you faithfully. Lovely.
No idea what that is, but it looks at you like you hung the moon.
insult: Whatever that is, it looks cleverer than its owner.
Did you make that yourself? It has the look of a first attempt.
remark: What in Guthix's name is that thing?
I've seen odd things follow adventurers. That's a new one.
kid/remark: What is that? Mum, what is that?
wizard/remark: That's no ordinary creature. There's old magic in it. Mind my books.

compliment: A little dragon! Mind it doesn't breathe on anything.
A dragon at heel. The White Knights would be green with envy.
insult: Your dragon's seen better days. Been dead a while, has it?
A dragon that small? I've had more trouble from a goose.
remark: That dragon's looking a bit peaky. Bit bony.
Is that dragon meant to be that colour? It looks cold.
kid/remark: A dragon! A real one! Does it burn things?
kid/compliment: Can I ride it? Please? I'm small.
nan/remark: That dragon looks half-starved, dear. Feed it something.
toff/compliment: A dragon, citizen! Rather a small one, but a dragon all the same.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! A little dragon of the north. A fine companion, outerlander.

compliment: A little storm cloud that follows you about. Rather fine, that.
I don't know what that is, but it's loyal. That counts for a lot.
insult: Your little cloud can't settle on a shape. Takes after you, I expect.
Your companion's a cloud. I've seen weather with more purpose.
remark: What is that? It keeps changing its mind.
Is it raining out of that thing? Keep it off the washing.
kid/remark: Yours is a cloud! How do you stroke a cloud?
wizard/remark: Pure chaos, bottled and walking. Who thought that was wise?
nan/remark: Ooh, I don't like the look of that one, dear. It's all swirly.

compliment: Terrifying little thing, and it dotes on you. Takes all sorts.
I'd not sleep near it, but it follows you like a lamb. Well done.
insult: That thing's given me the shivers. I hope you're pleased.
That thing looks like a bad dream. Find it under the bed, did you?
remark: Keep that away from me. I'll not sleep tonight.
Is it floating? Things shouldn't float.
kid/remark: I'm not scared of it. I'm not. Make it go away though.
vicar/remark: Saradomin preserve us. What is that following you?
nan/remark: Ooh no, dear. That one's not coming in my kitchen.

compliment: Three heads, and it still comes when you whistle. Impressive, that.
A dragon with three heads, and every one of them looks to you.
insult: Three heads, and not one of them thought to find a better owner?
Three heads. Between them they might make one sensible owner.
remark: Three heads on a baby dragon. That's two more than I'd like.
Which head do you feed? All of them? That'll cost you.
kid/remark: Three heads! Do they argue?
nan/remark: Three mouths to feed, dear. Rather you than me.
toff/remark: A prince among dragons, I suppose. It bows to no one, I'll wager.

compliment: Eight legs and it still keeps pace with you. Devoted, that.
A spider that minds its owner. Never seen the like.
insult: A spider for company. Couldn't afford a cat?
That spider has more manners than most adventurers I meet.
remark: There's a spider following you. A big one. Just so you know.
Where did you find a spider that size? No, don't tell me.
kid/remark: A spider! Is it poisonous? Does it eat flies? Can I have one?
nan/remark: A spider, dear? Keep it out of my bath.
vicar/remark: There's something unholy about that spider. Keep it off the pews.

compliment: Not pretty, that, but it's faithful. Prettier things aren't.
You must be something, for a creature like that to mind you.
insult: Is that yours, or has something followed you home from a crypt?
remark: Whatever that is, it's not from round here.
Something ghoulish about that creature. Keep it off the graves.
kid/remark: Ew! What is that? It's horrible. I love it.
vicar/remark: That thing has the stink of the undead about it. Mind the churchyard.
heartland/insult: That came from Morytania, didn't it. You can smell it from here.

compliment: All those heads, and every one of them looking up at you. Sweet.
A hydra that follows you. You must be a steady hand.
insult: All those heads, and still not a sensible one among the lot of you.
Are you sure it's following you, or were you just outvoted?
remark: All those heads. How does it not fall over?
Do all those heads agree on where it's going?
kid/remark: How many heads has it got? I counted and lost count.
banker/remark: One creature, several heads. We count it as one, for the record.
wizard/remark: A hydra, in miniature. Lose a head, does it grow two more? Try it.

compliment: A kalphite following you. Most folk run the other way. Well done.
That beetle's gleaming. Someone's been polishing it.
insult: A beetle the size of a dog. I do hope you've told the neighbours.
Your beetle's eyeing my sandwich. Trained it yourself, did you?
remark: That's a very large beetle.
Is that a kalphite? They get bigger, you know. Much bigger.
kid/remark: A beetle! A giant beetle! Does it fly? Make it fly!
nan/remark: Keep that beetle off my vegetables, dear.
trader/remark: Kalphite shell. I know a man who'd pay for that, my friend.

compliment: A little walking volcano, and it's tame. Fair play.
That thing glows like a hearth. Handy on a cold night.
insult: Your creature's smoking. Do you feed it coal?
A walking volcano. I've met adventurers with calmer tempers. Not many.
remark: There's smoke coming off that thing. Have you tried water?
kid/remark: It's a volcano! A tiny one! Does it erupt?
dwarf/remark: Rock and fire walking about together. Unnatural. Lovely, though.
heartland/remark: Keep that off the grass. It'll scorch.

compliment: A little gargoyle for a friend. Handsome thing, in a stony way.
Gargoyles usually sit on a roof and sulk. Yours follows you about.
insult: Your companion's a gargoyle. It's the stonier-faced of you two. Just.
remark: I can hear that thing flapping from here.
Is that a gargoyle? They're meant to stay on the roof.
kid/remark: It's made of stone! Can it fly? Why's it flapping then?
vicar/remark: We've a gargoyle on the church roof. I'd best check it's still there.
nan/remark: All that flapping. It'll give me a headache, dear.
heartland/insult: A gargoyle. Usually they stay on the church. Did you pinch it?

compliment: That little brute stomps like it owns the place. Fine company.
Fierce little thing. It'd take on a troll for you, I reckon.
insult: Your creature's shouting at me. Did you teach it, or did it teach you?
Small, loud, and stamping about. Which of you is in charge?
remark: It's shouting something. Can't hear a word.
Hear that stomping? That's your creature. Mind the floorboards.
kid/remark: It's shouting! What's it saying? Shout back!
guard/remark: Keep that thing quiet. We've had complaints about the stomping.
toff/insult: Does that thing ever stop bellowing? Rather like the peasantry.

compliment: Fine feathers on that bird. You keep it well.
A bird that size, and it stays at heel. That's trust.
insult: Is it a bird? It's too big for a bird. Did you feed it too much?
Big bird, that. Does it carry you, or do you carry it?
remark: That's a very large bird. Looks like it's thinking.
Those wings would take the hat off my head.
kid/remark: That bird's huge. Is it a chicken? It's not a chicken.
rough/remark: Keep it off the seed, that one. It'll have the lot.

compliment: A little winged lady with a sword. Rather dignified, that.
Wings and armour both. She's better turned out than most knights.
insult: Your companion's better armoured than you are. Has it noticed?
A little winged knight at heel. She's the one in charge, I take it?
remark: Is that a tiny angel? With a sword?
Wings on that one. Does it fly, or just look like it might?
kid/remark: Is that a fairy? It's got a sword! Fairies don't have swords!
vicar/compliment: A little winged warrior. Saradomin's own, by the look of it.

compliment: A little demon with two swords, and it heels like a hound. Fair play.
Fierce little devil. Nobody'll trouble you with that about.
insult: Where did that even come from? Actually, don't tell me.
remark: I can hear it stomping from here. Little legs, big feet.
kid/remark: A demon! A tiny one! Does it do fire? Make it do fire!
vicar/remark: A demon at your heel, traveller. Rather you than me.
shady/compliment: A demon with two blades. Now that's a proper companion.
heartland/insult: A demon following you about. The vicar will have questions.
heartland/remark: Is that a demon? It's a demon. Keep it off the church steps.

compliment: A kraken, on land, following you about. Not many could manage that.
Rare to see a sea beast so far from water. It must be fond of you.
insult: How is it walking? More to the point, how are you?
Has anyone told your kraken it's not in the sea? Somebody should.
remark: That thing's a long way from the sea.
Is that a squid? It's walking. Squids don't walk.
kid/remark: A squid! On legs! That's not allowed!
pirate/remark: Arr. I've seen what the big ones do to a ship. Keep it in yer pocket.
rough/remark: Keep that off the boats. The lads won't go out with that about.

compliment: A little smoke devil, tamed. Handy if the fire ever goes out.
I've no idea how you tamed that. Hats off.
insult: Is that smoke coming off your creature, or your cooking?
Follows you in a cloud of its own smoke. Which of you started it?
remark: Something's burning. No. Oh, it's that. Does it ever stop?
Is that thing giving off smoke? My eyes are watering.
kid/remark: It's smoking! Is it on fire inside? Is it?
nan/remark: All that smoke. You'll get soot on my washing, dear.
barkeep/remark: Take that outside. I get enough smoke off the hearth.

compliment: A serpent at heel. Most folk would've been bitten by now. Well done.
Handsome snake, that. Lovely colour.
insult: A snake for company. Did it pick you, or were you all that was left?
Your snake's eyeing my ankles. Trained it, have you?
remark: There's a snake following you. Thought you'd want to know.
That snake's a long way from the swamp.
kid/remark: A snake! Does it bite? Bite him, not me!
nan/remark: A snake, dear? Keep it out of my knitting basket.
trader/remark: Snakeskin, my friend. I know a tanner who'd pay well.

compliment: A little shadow that follows you. Loyal, in its way.
Not much to look at, but it never leaves your side. Rare, that.
insult: Is that yours, or did something follow you out of a nightmare?
A dark lump trailing you. Decide yourself if that's a compliment.
remark: What is that? It's giving me the shivers.
Is that thing even solid? I'd not try to stroke it.
kid/remark: Is that a ghost? You've got a ghost! Is it dead?
wizard/remark: That thing's not wholly of this world. Keep it away from my scrying.
vicar/remark: Something from the spirit realm, that. I'll say a prayer.

compliment: A sea beast that follows you up the beach. Few could manage that.
Fierce little thing. Nobody will bother you with that about.
insult: A spiky sea beast. Did you win it, or did it adopt you?
Your creature's all teeth and temper. I see where it gets it.
remark: What is that? Something from the sea, by the smell.
Spikes on that one. Mind the furniture.
kid/remark: It's spiky! Can I touch the spikes? Ow.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! A dagannoth pup. You've been to Waterbirth, outerlander.
rough/remark: Keep that off the nets. It'll have them in shreds.

compliment: Sweet little mole, that. Mind it doesn't dig up the road.
A mole with a sunny disposition. Rare, that.
insult: You keep a mole, and you've still got a garden? Can't have.
Did you dig that up, or did it dig you up?
remark: A mole! Shouldn't it be underground?
That mole's sniffing my boots. Fair enough.
kid/remark: A mole! Is it blind? Can it see me? Can it?
nan/compliment: Ooh, a dear little mole. Keep it off my lawn, mind.
rough/insult: A mole. I've spent half my life trying to get rid of those.

compliment: A bear cub! Sweet thing. Where's the mother?
That cub's growing. Bigger than your pack already.
insult: A bear cub. Lovely. And when it's grown, what then?
Your bear's sniffing my pie. I don't suppose it eats adventurers?
remark: A bear. In town. I'll just be over here, then.
That cub'll be the size of a house one day. Enjoy the quiet.
kid/remark: A bear! Can I hug it? It's a baby one. I'm allowed.
nan/remark: A bear cub, dear? I hope you're feeding it porridge.
rough/remark: Keep that off the honey.

compliment: A little skeleton, still following orders. Loyal beyond the grave.
Handsome bones, that one. Well kept.
insult: A walking skeleton. Have you been feeding it at all?
Your companion's all bones. You're not far behind, by the look of you.
remark: There's a skeleton following you. Does it know it's dead?
A skeleton with a sword. Mind, it looks well behaved.
kid/remark: A skeleton! Is it a real one? Where's its skin gone?
vicar/remark: The dead ought to rest, traveller. Yours is doing a jig.
nan/remark: Skin and bone, that one. Not even skin. Feed it something, dear.

compliment: A spider that stays at heel. Patient creature. Patient owner.
Lovely markings on that spider, if you like that sort of thing.
insult: A spider that size follows you about. I'd ask myself why.
Nobody else would walk with you, so you settled for the spider?
remark: A spider the size of a dog. Now I've seen everything.
kid/remark: Big spider! Big spider! Everyone come and look!
nan/remark: A spider, dear? I've a broom for those.
rough/remark: Blimey. That'd clear the barn of rats, that would.
heartland/remark: That spider's eyeing the rafters. Don't let it in my cottage.

compliment: A scorpion at heel. Mind the tail. You clearly do.
Not many could tame a scorpion. Steady hands, you've got.
insult: Mind the tail. The scorpion's, I mean. Yours is harmless enough.
A scorpion for company. Were the kittens all taken?
remark: That tail's up. Is that good or bad?
Keep that scorpion off the path. People have sandals on.
kid/remark: A scorpion! Does it sting? Has it stung you? Show me.
nan/remark: Mind where you let that sit, dear. Scorpions and chairs don't mix.

compliment: A fiery pup, and it heels. Who's a good... whatever you are.
That pup's a credit to you. Warm company, too.
insult: Your dog's on fire and you're just stood there. Marvellous.
A dog from the hot place. Does it fetch, or just burn the stick?
remark: Your dog's on fire. Is that normal?
That pup's warm enough to toast bread on.
kid/remark: A fire dog! Does it bite? Does the bite burn?
kid/compliment: I want one. Mum said no. Mum says no to everything.
nan/remark: Keep that pup off the hearth rug, dear. It's already burning.
vicar/remark: That hound came up from somewhere I'd rather not name.

compliment: An odd little thing, but it looks after you. That's what counts.
You've a soft heart, taking that in. Not everyone would.
insult: Did that follow you home, or did you follow it?
Your companion's all tentacles. Hard to say which end you talk to.
remark: What is that? All tentacles. Keep it off the mats.
That thing looks like it crawled out of somewhere dark.
kid/remark: Tentacles! Tentacles! Can it hold things?
wizard/remark: That's from the Abyss, or near it. Keep it away from my runes.

compliment: A little demon, well behaved. Rarer than it sounds.
That dark little fellow follows you like a shadow. Devoted, that.
insult: A little demon. Does it know you're in charge? Does it agree?
Your companion's a little dark one. Keeping you honest, I hope.
remark: Your creature's casting a very large shadow for its size.
kid/remark: It's a demon! A baby one! Is it evil? Is it a bit evil?
vicar/remark: A dark little spirit, that. I'd keep it out of the chapel.
shady/compliment: Spawn of darkness at your heel. Perhaps you're not so dull after all.
heartland/remark: Is that a demon? A small one? Mind the church.

compliment: A spider that minds you. There's trust for you.
Lovely colour on that spider. Not that I'd stroke it.
insult: It's got eight legs and it still can't get away from you.
A spider that size for company. Were the dogs all spoken for?
remark: A spider that size. Nobody else bothered by that?
That spider's eyeing the eaves. Don't let it near my roof.
kid/remark: A spider! Can it make a web big enough to catch a cow?
rough/remark: That'd clear the barn of rats. I'll lend you a barn.

compliment: A sea spirit, following you about. The fishermen will be jealous.
Angry little thing, but it follows you faithfully. Takes all sorts.
insult: Your creature's furious. Have you fed it? Have you apologised?
Small and cross and following you about. I know the feeling.
remark: That thing looks cross. Is it always like that?
Smells of the sea, that one. Keep it off the bread.
kid/remark: It's angry! Why's it angry? Did you make it angry?
rough/remark: The sea spat that one out, and no wonder.
pirate/remark: Arr. A sea spirit, small as it is. Keep it sweet or it'll sink ye.

compliment: A phoenix! Beautiful. Warm, too.
That bird glows like a hearth. Lovely on a cold night.
insult: Your bird's on fire. I'm sure it's fine.
A phoenix. Does it rise from the ashes, or just make them?
remark: Is that bird meant to be glowing?
kid/remark: A fire bird! Does it lay fire eggs?
nan/remark: Keep that bird off the curtains, dear.
wizard/compliment: A phoenix. Dies and comes back, they say. Handy trick.
heartland/remark: Keep that bird off the thatch. I like my roof.

compliment: A crystal beast. It catches the light like a chapel window.
That creature's made of crystal, and it heels. Remarkable.
insult: Your creature's see-through. Shame the same can't be said of you.
remark: Odd creature. It shimmers.
kid/remark: It's made of glass! Can I see through it? Can I see its dinner?
wizard/remark: Crystal, living and walking. Elven work, surely.
trader/remark: Crystal, is it? I'd give you a fair price for a leg. Joking. Mostly.
heartland/insult: Made of glass, that. One trip on the cobbles and you're sweeping it.
heartland/remark: Is that thing made of crystal? Don't let it near the cobbles.

compliment: Whatever that is, it's magnificent. In a terrifying way.
That creature keeps pace with you like a shadow. Devoted.
insult: Your creature moves faster than you. I'd think about that.
Something with wings and too many arms. Did you lose a bet?
remark: That thing moves quick. Too quick.
Wings and claws and I don't know what. Keep it off the path.
kid/remark: It's got wings and arms! Too many arms! Count them!
vicar/remark: Saradomin preserve us. That's no creature of this world.
wizard/remark: That's older than it looks. Much older. Mind where it steps.

compliment: A little walking statue. Fine workmanship on that.
That little guardian keeps step like a soldier. Well trained.
insult: A statue that follows you. Lonely, were you?
A walking statue. Does it do anything, or just judge quietly?
remark: Is that a statue? It moved. It definitely moved.
Desert work, that. You can tell by the gold.
kid/remark: The statue's walking! Statues don't walk! Make it stop!
dwarf/compliment: Now that's craftsmanship. Stone that walks. By Guthix.
wizard/remark: An automaton. Old desert magic in it, I'd say. Don't let it near mine.

compliment: From somewhere hot, that, and it loves you. Both rare round here.
Odd little creature, but it follows you like a shadow. Fond of you.
insult: Desert creature, far from home. Did you ask it first?
A desert creature, far from home. It misses the sand more than you.
remark: That's come a long way. Desert, by the look of it.
What is that? Not from round here, I'd say.
kid/remark: What is it? Is it from the desert? Is it hot? Can I touch it?

compliment: A grub with arms, and it adores you. Takes all sorts.
Odd creature, but it's loyal. That's worth more than looks.
insult: Is that a grub? With arms? Which of you thought that was a good idea?
A grub with arms. I'd say it suits you, but I'm far too polite.
remark: A grub that big, you'd want a very large bird.
That thing's got arms. Grubs don't usually have arms.
kid/remark: It's a worm with arms! Does it hug? Make it hug!
nan/remark: Ooh, I don't like that one, dear. Too many bits.
fremennik/remark: That came from the northern ice, outerlander. Keep it cold.

compliment: All teeth, that little fellow, and every one of them devoted to you.
Fine set of teeth on that. It keeps close to you, too.
insult: Teeth and a stare. It's judging you. It isn't wrong.
All those teeth. Did you choose it, or did it choose you?
remark: That thing's watching me. I don't care for it.
That many teeth on a creature that size. Mind your fingers.
kid/remark: Look at its teeth! Does it bite? Don't let it bite me.
toff/remark: Keep that off the hunting grounds, citizen. The hounds would talk.

compliment: A headless little fellow with an axe, and it heels. Remarkable.
That thing's loyal, I'll say that. No head, all heart.
insult: Your companion's got no head. Between the pair of you, that's one.
A headless thing with an axe. Is it following you, or hunting you?
remark: Where's its head? Has it got a head?
Keep that axe away from the fence posts.
kid/remark: It's got no head! Where does it eat? Where?
vicar/remark: A headless thing. Ye gods. I'll not ask where you found it.
rough/remark: Blimey. Lend it to me for the firewood.

compliment: A sea serpent, on dry land, keeping pace with you. Remarkable.
Odd creature, but it keeps close to you. Fond of you, that.
insult: Is that from the sea? It looks like it lost an argument with it.
Your creature looks like it's seen things. Where did you drag it from?
remark: What is that? Something from very deep water.
That thing's a long way from the sea.
kid/remark: A sea monster! A tiny one! Does it eat ships?
pirate/remark: Arr. Seen bigger. Not many, mind.
rough/remark: The nets wouldn't hold that. Keep it off the boats.

compliment: A little shadow that follows you. Rather beautiful, in its way.
Strange little thing, but it clearly adores you.
insult: Is that your companion, or your shadow finally giving up on you?
Your creature's half there. Not sure which half of you it takes after.
remark: Is that thing solid? It doesn't look solid.
Something shadowy at your heel. I'd not stroke it.
kid/remark: Is that a ghost? I can see through it! Hello, ghost!
wizard/remark: Shadow given form. Interesting. Keep it off my notes.
