vicar/remark: A shadow that walks. I'll light a candle for you.

compliment: A rat, and a handsome one. Didn't think I'd ever say that.
That rat's cleaner than most adventurers. Well kept.
insult: A rat for company. The sewers must've been thrilled to see you.
Your rat's sitting up like it owns the place. Does it?
remark: A rat that size, I'd be charging it rent.
Keep that rat out of my pantry.
kid/remark: A rat! A big one! Does it sit? Make it sit!
nan/remark: A rat, dear? I've a cat for those. Keep it close.
barkeep/remark: Not in my kitchen, that. The cook'll have a fit.

compliment: That creature has lovely manners. Better than most adventurers.
insult: Your companion's got better manners than you. It bowed. You didn't.
A feathered snake. Did you pick the polite one on purpose?
remark: Is that a snake with feathers? That's a snake with feathers.
Odd beast. It looks like it's about to say good day.
kid/remark: A snake with feathers! Does it fly? Does it bite? Both?
toff/insult: Now there's a creature with breeding. Rather more than its owner.
trader/remark: Feathers like that would fetch a price, my friend. Not that I'd ask.
heartland/compliment: A feathered serpent. It's got better posture than the Duke.

compliment: A little warrior in armour, and it heels. Impressive.
That little fellow stands like a champion. You must have earned it.
insult: A soldier the size of a boot, and it stands straighter than you.
A tiny soldier at heel. It's the one keeping you alive, I take it?
remark: Is that a tiny man in armour? With a spear?
That one looks like it's won a fight or two.
kid/remark: A tiny knight! Does it fight? Fight me! No wait.
guard/remark: Keep that spear pointed down. Even on a thing that size.
toff/compliment: A miniature champion. Rather splendid, citizen.

compliment: That demon looks down on everyone. Not you, though. Lucky.
A proud little creature. It's chosen well, I'll grant.
insult: Your creature looks down on me. It's smaller than my boot.
A little demon with a big opinion of itself. You've a type.
remark: That thing's sneering at me. It's the size of a cat.
Is that a demon? It looks very pleased with itself.
kid/remark: It's a demon! It looked at me funny! I'll look back!
vicar/remark: A demon with pride in its eye. I'd watch that, traveller.
shady/compliment: A demon that holds its head high. Finally, something worth seeing.

compliment: Frosty little thing. Keeps the butter cool, I'd think.
A creature of ice, and it's taken to you. Warm heart, cold friend.
insult: Is that thing made of ice? Mind, it's the warmer of you two.
Your creature's leaving puddles. You can explain that to the landlord.
remark: Is that thing frozen? It's dripping.
Cold coming off that one. Stand upwind.
kid/remark: It's made of ice! Can I lick it? Don't tell Mum.
nan/remark: Wrap it up warm, dear. Oh. Right. It's made of cold.

compliment: I don't know what that is, but it would die for you. Would you for it?
A dark little thing that follows you like a shadow. Loyal.
insult: A little dark one. Did it follow you home, or did you follow it?
Something from the deep places. I'd ask how, but you'd tell me.
remark: I don't like the look of that one.
kid/remark: What is that? Is it a monster? Is it your monster?
vicar/remark: Something unholy at your heel, traveller. I'll pray for you both.
heartland/remark: Keep that thing in the daylight, where I can see it.

compliment: A tiny queen of insects, and she's chosen you. Honoured, I'd say.
Fine shell on that creature. Someone's been polishing.
insult: An insect the size of a sheep. The neighbours must be delighted.
Your bug's got better posture than you. Just so you know.
remark: That's a very large insect.
Is it laying eggs? Tell me it's not laying eggs.
kid/remark: A bug! A giant bug! Does it lay eggs? Can I have one?
nan/remark: Keep that off my cabbages, dear. Bugs that size eat a row a night.

compliment: A little chompy chick. Sweet thing.
Lovely little bird. The ogres would eat it, mind. Keep it close.
insult: That bird's loud for its size. Takes after its owner.
A chompy chick. Did you hunt it, or just outrun it?
remark: Is that a chompy? Tiny one. Loud, though.
That chick's pecking at my boots. Fair enough.
kid/remark: A birdy! It's shouting! Shout back!
nan/compliment: Ooh, a dear little bird. Mind the cat, now.

compliment: A fine hound. Good nose on it, I'd say.
That dog looks like it could find anything. Lovely animal.
insult: Good dog, that. I'd follow it rather than you.
That hound finds things, does it? Can it find your manners?
remark: That hound's got its nose to the ground. Found something?
Fine dog. Does it dig? Keep it off my garden if it does.
kid/compliment: A dog! Good boy! Are you a good boy? He is.
rough/remark: Keep it off the sheep, that one.
guard/remark: Keep your dog on a lead in town. Fine animal, mind.

compliment: It watches over you like a dog over a bone. There's loyalty.
A proper little guardian, that. You've earned it.
insult: It's guarding you, is it? It's got its work cut out.
A little horror from somewhere dark. Did it come with a warning?
remark: That thing's got a look about it. I'd not turn my back.
Is that thing watching me? It's watching me.
kid/remark: It's a monster! A little one! Does it bite? Does it guard?
wizard/remark: Abyssal, that. Keep it well away from the altar.

compliment: What a colourful bird! Lovely feathers.
That bird's a picture. Sunrise on wings.
insult: That bird's prettier than you. I'm sure you've heard.
Is that bird following you, or are you following it?
remark: Bright bird, that. Not from round here.
That bird's watching me. Birds don't usually watch.
kid/remark: A rainbow bird! Does it talk? Say something!
trader/remark: Feathers like those, my friend. I know a hatter who'd pay.

compliment: A gull at heel. Most of them just steal your fish.
Fine bird, that. Well fed, too.
insult: A seagull for company. Did it steal your dinner and refuse to leave?
Your gull's eyeing my lunch. Trained it yourself, did you?
remark: Is that scrongly little chicken following you?
kid/remark: A seagull! Mine! I want it! It's a chicken, isn't it?
pirate/remark: Arr. A gull. Follows ye for the scraps, same as the rest of us.
rough/remark: Keep that off the nets. Gulls and nets, there's no winning.
heartland/remark: That gull's eyeing the fish stall. Keep it close.

compliment: A boar with a garden on its back. Lovely thing.
Smells like a herb garden, that boar. Very pleasant.
insult: Your boar's better dressed than you. Greener, anyway.
A pig in a herb coat. Dinner follows you about, does it?
remark: That boar's covered in herbs. Are you planning to eat it?
Is that a pig? With a hedge on it?
kid/remark: A pig! A green pig! Can I ride it? I'm riding it.
nan/remark: Those herbs want drying properly, dear. I'll not say how.
barkeep/remark: Seasons itself, does it? Handy.

compliment: A floating eye that trails you like a hound. Oddly touching.
Strange little spirit. It's chosen well.
insult: Your creature's floating. Does it carry your bags? No? Shame.
A floating something. Did you summon it or just find it?
remark: What is that? It's floating and I don't like it.
Is that thing watching me? It's all eye.
kid/remark: It's a floating eye! Blink! Make it blink!
wizard/remark: Soul magic in that, or I'm a goblin. Keep it off my desk.

compliment: A spider with manners. It bowed, I swear it did.
Very fine spider. Well groomed, if you can groom a spider.
insult: A gentleman spider, and you. One of you is dressed for company.
Your spider's the respectable one of you two. I'd ask it for a loan.
remark: There's a spider following you. A big one. It looks respectable.
Eight legs and it still walks like it owns the road.
kid/remark: Spider! It's got fangs! Does it crawl in your mouth at night?
nan/remark: A spider, dear? I'd not have it on the bed. Not even a polite one.

compliment: A little giant! Tiny, but it stands like a king.
That little fellow struts like royalty. Fine company.
insult: A tiny giant. Make up your mind.
Your companion's a giant the size of a boot. Does it know?
remark: Is that a giant? A very small one?
Short temper on that one, I'd say. Or very long. Hard to tell.
kid/remark: A tiny giant! That's not a giant! That's a man!
fremennik/remark: Hah! A giant in your pocket. Tell the hunters, outerlander.
toff/remark: A king in miniature. One wonders where its kingdom is.

compliment: Ooh, fluffy! Don't those go bang?
Sweet little fluffy thing. Lovely colour.
insult: A chinchompa. I'd stand a bit further from the fire. Both of you.
Fluffy, isn't it. So's a bale of hay, and look what happens to those.
remark: Is that a chinchompa? Keep it away from the lamp.
Fluffy little thing. It's twitching. Why is it twitching?
kid/remark: Fluffy! Can I hold it? Does it go bang? Make it go bang!
nan/compliment: Ooh, isn't it soft. Keep it off the hearth, mind.
trader/remark: Hunters pay well for those, my friend. Not that one, I know.

compliment: A beaver! Handsome creature. Fine teeth.
Hard worker, a beaver. Good company for a woodcutter.
insult: Your beaver's eyeing the table legs. Did you not feed it?
A beaver. Does it do the chopping while you watch?
remark: That beaver's looking at my fence. Don't let it.
Keep that away from the door frame.
kid/remark: A beaver! Do its teeth grow forever? Show me!
rough/remark: Keep that off my woodpile.
dwarf/compliment: Now there's a creature that respects timber. Fine teeth.

compliment: Fine creature. The forest's taken a liking to you, I'd say.
Well kept, that. The woods look after their own.
insult: Out of the forest and into town. It looks more surprised than you.
remark: That's come straight out of the forest.
kid/remark: Is it from the woods? Can I keep it? I'll feed it.
heartland/insult: A woodland creature. The gamekeeper will want a word.
heartland/remark: Keep that away from the chickens.

compliment: A squirrel that size. Must be well fed. Well done.
Lovely markings on that squirrel. Big, though.
insult: A squirrel the size of a dog. Still quicker up a tree than you.
Your squirrel's eyeing my basket. Well brought up, is it?
remark: That's a big squirrel. Nobody else mentioning how big that is?
Keep that off the roof. It'll have the tiles off.
kid/remark: Big squirrel! Does it climb? Climb the church! Go on!
nan/remark: Ooh, isn't it big. Keep it off the bird table, dear.

compliment: A heron, keeping step with you. Fine long legs on it.
Handsome bird. Patient, too, standing like that.
insult: A heron. Does it do the fishing while you hold the bucket?
That bird's caught more fish than you have today, I'd wager.
remark: Long legs on that bird. Does it keep up?
kid/remark: A big bird! Why's it standing on one leg? Is the other one broken?
rough/remark: Keep that off the nets. It'll have the catch.
pirate/compliment: Arr. Fine fishing bird, that. Worth its weight in cod.
heartland/remark: That bird's eyeing the fish stall, you know.

compliment: A floating guardian. Where did you even find a lead for that?
Odd little thing, but it clearly looks after you.
insult: Your creature floats. Does it do the walking for you as well?
A floating rock with eyes. Did the wizards have a sale on?
remark: Is that thing floating? Things shouldn't float.
What is that? It's humming.
kid/remark: It's floating! How's it floating? Is it on a string?
wizard/compliment: A rift creature. You've been through the Abyss, then. Brave. Or lost.
vicar/remark: A floating thing. I'd not bring that into church.

compliment: A little walking rock. Solid company, that.
Fine little golem. Well polished, too.
insult: A rock for company. Cheaper to feed than a dog, I'll grant you.
Your companion's a rock. It's the livelier of you two.
remark: Your rock's following you. Is it meant to do that?
Did that rock just move? Tell me it didn't.
kid/remark: The rock's walking! Can I kick it? No, it'd hurt.
dwarf/compliment: A golem! Hah! Now that's a mining companion. By Guthix, fine ore.
rough/remark: Blimey. If my rocks did that I'd never mine another.

compliment: Lovely coat on that little fellow. Well brushed.
That one's got a clever face. Takes after its owner, I hope.
insult: Your creature's got a thief's face. I'll be checking my pockets.
Your animal wears a mask. Honest work, is it? For either of you?
remark: Keep an eye on that little fellow. It's eyeing my purse.
That creature's got a mask on. Nature or choice?
kid/remark: It's wearing a mask! Is it a robber? Are you a robber?
guard/remark: Keep that animal in sight. We've had things go missing.
banker/remark: Would you mind keeping that creature away from the counter?

compliment: A walking plant! Well watered, by the look of it.
Lovely little tree. Someone's been tending it.
insult: A plant for company. Did it grow on you?
Your creature needs watering. So do you, by the look of things.
remark: Your plant's following you. Plants don't usually do that.
kid/remark: A walking tree! Does it talk? Trees don't talk. Does it?
nan/compliment: Ooh, a dear little tree. Does it want a bigger pot, dear?
rough/remark: If my crops walked about like that I'd never get the harvest in.
heartland/remark: Keep that away from the goats.

compliment: Lovely cat. Well looked after, that.
A cat at heel. Must like you. They don't like many.
insult: Your cat's giving me a look. It's not a kind one. Trained it yourself?
A cat, is it? The rats round here will be laughing. It looks well fed.
remark: That cat's got its eye on something. It's not you.
kid/compliment: A kitty! Here, kitty! Why won't it come? Make it come!
nan/compliment: Ooh, a cat. Good for the rats, dear. Has it had its milk?
barkeep/remark: Cats are welcome. They sort the cellar.
heartland/remark: Keep that cat off the fish stall.

compliment: A red cat! Never seen one that colour. Handsome.
That cat's glowing. Warm lap on a winter night.
insult: Your cat's a funny colour. Been near the fire, has it? Both of you?
A cat the colour of a hot coal. I'd not let it on the bed.
remark: Is that cat on fire? It looks on fire.
Where did you find a cat that colour? Don't tell me.
kid/remark: A fire cat! Is it hot? I'm touching it. Ow.
nan/remark: A red cat, dear? Keep it off the curtains.

compliment: A little stone angel, and it follows you. Someone up there likes you.
remark: Is that a statue? It's walking. Statues shouldn't walk.
That little stone thing's glowing. Is it meant to glow?
kid/remark: It's got wings! Can it fly? It's made of stone! It can't fly!
vicar/remark: Wings and a halo of light. I'd like a word with whoever carved it.

compliment: A little bull in a bow tie. Very smart. Smarter than most.
Well turned out, that calf. Somebody's proud of it.
remark: Why is your calf wearing a bow tie? Is it going somewhere?
kid/compliment: A cow in a bow tie! Does it moo? Make it moo!
rough/remark: Good bit of beef, that. Don't look at me like that, I'm only saying.
nan/compliment: Ooh, a little calf all dressed up. Is it off to a wedding, dear?

insult: A maggot's following you. A big one. I'd have a wash, if I were you.
remark: Is that a maggot? Why is it so big? Why is it following you?
Something's crawling about in that thing. I'd rather not look.
kid/remark: Ew! It's a giant grub! Can I keep it? Mum says no.
nan/remark: Keep that wriggly thing off my step, dear. Off the larder too.
vicar/remark: That came out of something that died. I'll pray for you both.

compliment: A goat at heel. Good-natured one too, by the look of him.
insult: Your goat's chewing on something. Hope it's not my washing.
remark: That goat's looking at me like it knows something.
kid/compliment: A goat! Does it headbutt? Make it headbutt that man!
fremennik/compliment: A fine goat. Hardy stock. It would do well in the snow.
heartland/remark: Keep that goat off the vegetable patch, would you?

compliment: A little turtle! Takes its time, doesn't it? Wise creature.
Lovely shell on that turtle. Someone keeps it polished.
remark: Your turtle's sniffing at the soup pot. I'd watch that.
kid/compliment: A turtle! Can it go in its shell? Make it go in its shell!
pirate/compliment: A turtle aboard ship is good luck, sailor. Mostly for the cook.
barkeep/remark: Keep that turtle out of the stew pot, eh? Or in it. Your choice.

compliment: Sturdy little swine, that. Well fed, by the look of it.
remark: That hog's not moving. Is it meant to follow you, or not?
Your little swine smells of the swamp. Keep it downwind.
kid/remark: A little pig! It's all hairy! Does it want a mushroom?
rough/remark: Hairy little hog. Keep it out of my turnips.

compliment: A fish in a bowl, carried all this way. That's devotion.
remark: You're walking about with a fishbowl. Fair enough, I suppose.
kid/compliment: A fish! Can I feed it? Can I tap the glass? Please?
nan/compliment: Ooh, a little fish. Don't let the cat see it, dear.
barkeep/remark: Keep that bowl off the bar. Fish don't drink, I've found.

compliment: Is that the mayor? Very kind of you to carry him about.
insult: You've stolen the mayor. Catherby's going to want him back.
remark: Isn't that the fish they made mayor? He looks very serious.
That fish has a very official look about him. Good posture.
kid/remark: Mum says that fish is in charge of a whole town. Is it true?
toff/remark: A fish in office. I've known worse. I've voted for worse.

compliment: A rock that follows you. No feeding, no fuss. Sensible.
insult: You're walking a rock. I'd not say that out loud, in your place.
remark: Is that rock following you, or are you following it?
kid/remark: Your rock's walking! Mine just sits there. Can yours do tricks?
fremennik/compliment: A good rock. Loyal. It will never leave your side, outerlander.

compliment: A wind-up cat! Clever work. The joints move ever so smoothly.
remark: That cat's ticking. Cats don't tick. What's wrong with it?
That cat's walking a bit stiff. Is it made of wood?
kid/compliment: A toy cat that walks! Who wound it up? Can I wind it?
gnome/compliment: Lovely gearing on that cat. Not bad for a human, that.

compliment: A chocolate egg that walks about. That's the best kind of egg.
kid/compliment: A chocolate egg! With legs! Can I have a bite? Just a little one?
nan/compliment: Ooh, a chocolate egg. Mind it doesn't go soft, dear.
toff/remark: Is that egg painted? Rather garish. Still, it's chocolate.
heartland/remark: Your egg's following you. Keep it out of the sun, it'll melt.

insult: Your chair's following you. I'd not sit in it.
remark: That chair just moved on its own. I saw it.
Why is there a chair behind you? Who brought a chair?
kid/remark: The chair's walking! It's haunted! Can I sit on it? No! Yes!
vicar/remark: There's something in that chair. I'd not sit in it, traveller.
nan/remark: A chair that follows you about? Handy, at my age.

compliment: A smiling egg. Can't help but smile back, can you?
remark: That egg's following you. And smiling. Don't drop it.
Careful with that egg, it's got a face. Someone painted a face on it.
kid/compliment: Your egg's smiling at me! Hello, egg! Is it going to hatch?
nan/remark: Mind that egg, dear. One tumble and it'll be breakfast.

compliment: Lovely dog. Well kept, and it never takes its eyes off you.
Good dog, that. You can tell. Look at it wag.
insult: Your dog's better turned out than you are, traveller.
remark: That dog's sniffing about for something. Lost a bone, has it?
kid/compliment: A doggy! Can I stroke it? Does it do tricks? Make it sit!
guard/remark: Keep that dog on a short leash, citizen. It's got a nose for trouble.
nan/compliment: Ooh, a good dog. Has it had its dinner, dear? I've a bone.
heartland/remark: Keep that dog off the butcher's stall, would you?

compliment: A puppy! All paws and ears. It'll be a fine dog one day.
Look at that little puppy trotting after you. Lovely.
remark: Your puppy's chewing something. I'd check your boots.
kid/compliment: A puppy! Can I hold it? Can I name it? I'm calling it Biscuit!
nan/compliment: Oh, a little puppy. Give it a cuddle from me, dear.
rough/remark: Big paws on that pup. It'll grow into them soon enough.

cat/remark: Is that thing yours? It's looking at me. Tell it to stop.
Your creature's following you. I'd never be so obvious.
cat/insult: Keep your creature away from my patch. I was here first.
cat/compliment: Your creature knows to keep its distance. Clever thing.

slayer_master/remark: Still on {task}, I see. Don't let me keep you.
I gave you {task}, not a stroll. Get moving.
How are you getting on with {task}? Don't answer. Go.
Read up on {task} before you go in. Saves a funeral.
slayer_master/compliment: Making short work of {task}, by the look. Good.
You've the look of someone who's been at {task}. Keep at it.
slayer_master/insult: Still not done with {task}? I'd have finished twice by now.
Is it {task} still? You're taking your time about it.
guard/remark: Off after {task}, is it? Good. Fewer of them, fewer of my problems.
If {task} follow you home, that's a report. Mine.
guard/insult: Sent after {task}? Don't bring any back through the gate.
guard/compliment: Someone's got to deal with {task}. Rather you than the watch.

slayer_master/compliment: Nearly through {task}, by the look of you. Good work.
Almost done with {task}? Come and see me after.
Not many {task} left for you, eh? Finish the job.
slayer_master/remark: Nearly there. Don't get careless at the end.
slayer_master/insult: Nearly done and still standing. I'm almost impressed.

slayer_master/remark: No task? Come and see me, I've plenty.
Idle hands, adventurer. I've monsters that need killing.
slayer_master/compliment: You look ready for a new assignment. I've just the thing.
slayer_master/insult: Taking a holiday, are we? The monsters aren't.

compliment: You're looking well, traveller.
Lovely to see a friendly face.
You've got a kind face, you.
insult: Face like a wet weekend, you.
plain/insult: Plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself.
You've the sort of face that improves with a helmet.
remark: Could murder a cup of tea.
toff/compliment: What a charming young adventurer.
toff/insult: One doesn't often see the peasantry so well turned out. Nearly.
toff/remark: I have a kingdom to run, you know. Well, a corner of one.
trader/compliment: Looking's free. Touching isn't. Buying's encouraged.
trader/insult: Yours came off the cheap shelf. I know. I sold it to you.
trader/remark: Everything must go! Well, some things.
barkeep/compliment: Good to see you, love. Usual?
barkeep/insult: What'll it be? Besides a wash.
You've a thirst on you, I can tell. And a tab, I'll bet.
barkeep/remark: Rats in the cellar again. Don't tell anyone.
banker/insult: Oh. It's you. You never use the bank.
banker/remark: Deposits to the left. Complaints to the Duke.
nan/compliment: Ooh, haven't you grown!
Lovely to see you, dear. You've a bit more colour today.
nan/insult: Mind your manners, dear. I've turned nicer people into toads.
nan/remark: In my day we walked everywhere. Uphill.
vicar/compliment: Lovely to see a new face. Most of mine are on gravestones.
vicar/insult: Saradomin loves us all. He does have to work at it, with some.
vicar/remark: Do come along to the church fete. Bring a cake.
wizard/compliment: You have an aura about you, traveller. A good one.
wizard/insult: An adventurer. Fetching and carrying for cleverer people, I expect.
wizard/remark: Not now. I'm concentrating on a very difficult spell.
rough/insult: Some of us have work to do. Go and bother a goblin.
Treasure hunters. Ye'll be after my shed next.
rough/remark: Blimey. Not another one of you treasure hunters.
Rain's coming. My knee says so.
shady/compliment: You've potential. The wrong sort. My sort.
shady/insult: Your sort aren't welcome round here.
dwarf/compliment: Fancy a pie? No? More for me.
You'll do, human. For a human.
Sturdy sort, aren't you? Nearly dwarven.
dwarf/insult: Big folk. Always in a hurry, never any good at it.
Talk to a dwarf, do you? Most humans just look over us.
You'd make a fine miner, human. Once you learnt to stoop.
dwarf/remark: If a job's worth doing, do it well. Then have a pie.
Kelda stout's the only drink worth the name. Pity it's rare.
Gold and rock, human. Everything else is just talk.
gnome/compliment: Nice to see an outsider, human. You lot get taller every year.
You've a kind face, for one so tall.
Welcome, human. Try a cocktail before you go. Blurberry's finest.
You've a good step on you, for one of the big folk.
gnome/insult: You've the build for gnomeball, human. As the ball.
Humans. Big, slow, and always asking the way.
Mind the branch, human. Big folk never look up.
gnome/remark: The gliders don't stop for humans. They barely stop for us.
The children say a new world will rise from underground. Children.
King Narnode sends his regards. He sends them to everyone.
Ever played gnomeball, human? It's a bit rough on the big folk.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! You have a warrior's look about you.
Well met. You look like one who has a tale worth a beer.
You have the walk of someone the bards would not forget.
fremennik/insult: You walk like a southerner, outerlander. All knees.
Hah! You'd not last one trial, outerlander. Not even Manni's.
Southerners talk a great deal. I will wait for the useful part.
You look like someone Peer would set a riddle for. A short one.
fremennik/remark: The spirits are restless today.
The longhall's loud tonight. Manni's buying.
The Longhall will be loud tonight. It is loud every night.
pirate/compliment: Arr, ye've the look of a sea dog.
Ye've a steady eye, matey. Ever thought of a life at sea?
pirate/insult: Arr, ye'd not last a day at sea, landlubber.
Arr, ye walk like the deck's moving, and we're on land.
pirate/remark: Arr, the Customs men are on the warpath again.
kid/compliment: You're ace. My mum says you're not, though.
kid/insult: You smell funny.
Why are you walking like that?
kid/remark: Got any sweets?
I'm not allowed to talk to strangers.
burgher/compliment: You got a kind face. Not many round here do.
Nice to see a face that ain't grey.
burgher/insult: You ain't from round here. Too much colour in your cheeks.
burgher/remark: Someone put a notice up. Can't read it. Looked important.
Mud's deep today. Mud's deep every day.
burgher/gossip: There's letters on the church door. Nobody knows what they say.
slayer_master/remark: Know your enemy. Half the job is knowing what kills you.
Every creature has a weakness. Find it before it finds yours.
Some monsters can only be hurt the right way. Remember that.
A sharp eye and a sharp blade. Not much else matters.
slayer_master/insult: You'd not last a day on a proper assignment.
Have you even got a nose peg?
heartland/remark: Looks like rain. It always looks like rain.
More goblins about these days, they say.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt again. Always JalYt. Where do all the JalYt come from?
Warm day. Every day warm. Is good. JalYt still complain.
You walk past TzHaar, TzHaar walk past you. Fair.
tzhaar/compliment: This JalYt not asking questions. Best JalYt all day.
JalYt looks warm today. Good. Keep it that way.
tzhaar/insult: Another JalYt. Lava does not care. TzHaar does not either.
ogre/remark: Chompies is scarce today. Me belly is complaining.
Yous is a creature. Me is an ogre. Dat is how it is.
Ogre is bored. Bored ogre is hungry ogre. Walk faster, creature.
ogre/insult: Grrr. Creature is too skinny to bother wiv. Come back fatter.
Yous walks funny, creature. Like a toady wiv a stabber in it.
ogre/compliment: Hur, hur. Creature got a goodly face. Not for eating. Just goodly.
moon_clan/compliment: Oh my. A quiet mind, for a visitor. Thank you for that.
You were going to say something kind. I know. Thank you, dear.
moon_clan/insult: No need to say it, dear. I heard it. I did not care for it.
Your thoughts are very loud today, dear. Mainland habits.
moon_clan/remark: I dreamt of you last night. Do not worry, it was quite dull.
tortugan/compliment: You stop to talk. Most tourists only hurry past.
A calm face, for a human. That is rare, and welcome.
tortugan/insult: Humans are in a hurry even standing still. Very well. Off you go.
You will have moved on before I finish this sentence. There. Gone.
tortugan/remark: A shell is a fine thing. Never in a hurry, always at home.
goblin/remark: Red armour best! No wait, brown. Brown best now. Me forget.
Worm stew again tonight. Me want beetle pie. Beetle pie give wind.
What you doing here, human? Me not sure that allowed.
Generals arguing again. Me not know what about. Nobody know.
Goblins mighty, war good, Big High War God greatest god!
Me not think today. Thinkers must die. Priest say so.
goblin/insult: Go away smelly human. Goblins busy.
Human ugly! All humans ugly. This one more.
goblin/compliment: You not bad, for human. Me not say that to many humans.
Human smell nearly like goblin. Is compliment.
troll/remark: Goat for dinner again. Me ask for human. Me get goat.
Trolls named after first thing we eat. Human named after what?
Goutweed in da stew tonight. Goutweed in everything. Is good.
Trolls not like boats. Boat go up an' down. Troll go down.
Fire bad. Rocks good. Dat is all troll need to know.
Trolls chuck rocks. Humans run. Dat is how it go.
Me not eat since breakfast. Breakfast was big, though.
Thrower trolls got best job. Chuck rock, sit down, chuck rock.
troll/insult: Human look like lunch. Early lunch.
What human do up here? Human not even crunchy.
Puny human. Lalli call you dat too, an' Lalli live in cave.
troll/compliment: Polite human. Polite humans taste... no. Polite humans is nice. Good.
Good human. Me not say dat much. Me not say much at all.
cat/remark: Something smells of fish. Is it you? Say it's you.
You're between me and the sun. Shift.
I was asleep. Now I'm not. Think about what you've done.
Rats in the walls here. I'm not on duty. Not today.
Humans talk so much. Say what you mean. Then feed me.
cat/compliment: Warm hands, you. I'll allow a stroke. One.
You walk quietly, for a human. Nearly like a cat.
cat/insult: Do you ever stop talking? The mice can hear you from here.
Dogs have owners, cats have staff. You look like staff.
camel/remark: The sun's got no mercy today. It never has.
I was composing a poem. You've rather trodden on the metre.
Shade. Water. A little quiet. Is that so much to ask?
camel/compliment: You stopped to listen. Hardly anyone stops. Thank you.
You walk gently. The sand thanks you, and so do I.
camel/insult: Did you say something? Only I was thinking of someone nicer.
You stare so. Were you raised in a tent?
leprechaun/remark: 'Tis a foine day for it, whatever it is ye're at.
Mebbe ye'd be wantin' yer stuff back? Nay? Suit yerself.
A magic shed, we have. Don't ask me where. I don't rightly know.
leprechaun/compliment: Ye've the look of someone who waters their patch. Foine.
Ye walk like a body who's never lost a trowel. Rare, that.
leprechaun/insult: Ye must be dafter than ye look, and ye look plenty daft.
Were yez wantin' me, or just blockin' me light?
parrot/remark: Squawk! Feed the fires! Feed the fires!
parrot/compliment: Squawk! What will it be? What will it be?
parrot/insult: Squawk! Leave me alone! Leave me alone!
mos_pirate/remark: What ship did ye pull in on, stranger?
Arr, that it be. Whatever it was ye said.
Keep yer voice down. The powder monkey's sleepin' it off.
mos_pirate/compliment: Aye, good day te ye too.
Ye've the look of a proper fillibuster about ye.
mos_pirate/insult: What's a landlubber like ye doin' here?
moon_clan_wary/insult: I can hear what you are thinking. Don't.
Picking at our secrets, like the rest of them. I can hear it.
You think very loudly for someone with so little to say.
Outsiders are so easy to read. I wish you were worth reading.
You were about to ask something. The answer is no.
Patience and interest. Show me either, and we might talk.
I read your mind. It did not take long.
The Fremennik never listen. You have the look of one who does not.
moon_clan_wary/remark: We do not suffer outsiders easily. Do keep walking.
Our secrets are our own. Do stop thinking about them.
A wise man listens. Try it.
You have not earned the right to anything of ours. Yet.
Mainlanders always want something. I am waiting to hear what.
The Fremennik broke our altars. We keep our secrets closer now.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: You listen, at least. More than most of your kind manage.
Your thoughts are quieter than most outsiders'. Only slightly.
Not entirely ignorant. For a mainlander, that is high praise.
There may be some insight in you. Very well hidden.
guard/remark: Twelfth hour on this gate. Or thirteenth. I've stopped counting.
Nothing to report. Nothing to report. I could say it in my sleep.
The sergeant says stand up straight. The sergeant isn't here.
Counted the carts in. Now I count them out. That's the job.
Feet went numb an hour ago. The rest of me is catching up.
Rations again. If you can call a turnip rations.
The captain's on inspection. Has been since breakfast. In the pub.
Quiet shift. Don't say it. You'll jinx it.
Word is there's trouble coming. Word is always that. Still here.
Paperwork for the paperwork now. The sergeant invented a form for it.
Bells go, I go home. Bells haven't gone. So here I stand.
My relief's late. My relief is always late. I think he's a rumour.
Nobody's tried the gate all day. Bit insulting, really.
A cat came through the gate earlier. Didn't stop for questions.
Guarding, mostly. Standing, technically.
Someone's been chalking rude words on the wall. Not me. Officially.
They promised a new helmet. That was three sergeants ago.
guard/compliment: You walked through without causing a fuss. Rarer than you'd think.
Watched you cross the square. No bother. I appreciate that.
You've the look of someone who pays their tolls. Carry on.
guard/insult: State your business. Loitering counts as business, by the way.
You've walked past this post more than once. I'm writing it down.
Nothing in your hands. Which is exactly what a thief would say.
Looking at the gate a lot, aren't you. Gates are for walking through.
Anything to declare? No? That's what they all say.
barbarian/remark: Yyeeeaaarrrggh! Try it. Go on. Louder.
Sword, axe and arrow for us. The gods can keep their magic.
The longhall fire never goes out. Nor does the beer.
We came down from the mountains with Gunnar. We're not going back.
Nothing happens in this village without a fight breaking out. Good.
The beer's in the longhall. The meat's in the longhall. Go on, then.
barbarian/insult: What do you want, little one? Not a fight, I can tell.
Soft city folk. Never know what they want. Bah!
You look funny. No, really. Has nobody told you?
Strolling through our village teaches you nothing. Bah!
barbarian/compliment: You've the look of someone who'd scream and charge. Good.
Not bad, for an outsider. The longhall might even let you in.
